jobs.title: Knock: Lending Manager (Front End) - Remote
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

Knock is redefining the home buying and selling experience, and we’re only getting started! We’re a passionate team of industry experts who knew there had to be a better, simpler way for people to navigate the journey between homes. That people-first mindset is core to how we operate, and why Knock has been honored as one of Inc.’s Best Workplaces six times in the past seven years.

We bring that mindset into the work we do every day.  The Knock Bridge Loan™ empowers homebuyers to ‘buy before they sell’, by unlocking the equity in their current home, giving them greater convenience, certainty, and competitiveness. 

Founded in 2015, Knock has grown into a trusted partner for thousands of homebuyers and a network of 60,000+ loan officers and agents across the country. Backed by top investors like Foundry Group, Trinity Capital, and the National Association of Realtors, we’ve built a reputation for innovation and trust, earning 900+ five-star Zillow and Trustpilot reviews and an A+ BBB rating. 

Join our growing team and help shape the future of homebuying! To learn more, visit Knock.com

Lending Manager (Front End)

About the role

Knock is looking for an experienced mortgage leader to manage and grow our team of fully remote Loan Assistants. This is a 100% remote role, and you’ll lead a team distributed across the country. You enjoy building teams, finding efficiencies, and using technology to improve how work gets done. You’re approachable, open-minded, and adaptable. You know the work well enough to coach it and you’re willing to jump in and help. In this role you’ll own the Loan Assistant and post-closing pipelines, develop your team, and work with the Director of Lending Operations to make our processes better.

What you’ll do:

Lead and develop the team

  • Manage, lead, and scale the remote Loan Assistant team.
  • Share weekly, monthly, quarterly, and annual team and company goals, and make sure the team meets and exceeds expectations.Hold team members accountable for their performance.
  • Build camaraderie and teamwork in a virtual environment through team meetings and regular 1:1 check-ins.
  • Run virtual training for new Loan Assistants and serve as the team’s go-to for escalations, questions, and exceptions.
  • Mentor people inside and outside your team, and keep learning yourself.
  • Document conversations in our HRIS and build a sense of ownership across the team.

Own the pipeline

  • Manage the bridge loan pipeline from setup through initial disclosure and submission, and through post-closing.
  • Coach the team and give feedback along the way.Balance workloads across the team to meet company SLAs.
  • Support post-closing review.
  • Work loans that have findings with the team member responsible and get them resolved.
  • Work closely with Sales, Underwriting, and Closing to give everyone timely, accurate service.
  • Compile team scorecard data each quarter to track KPIs and quality.

Improve how we work

  • Help the Director of Lending Operations find gaps in process and policy across the Loan Assistant and post-closing functions.
  • Write or update procedures for review, training, and rollout, then follow up to make sure the changes stick.
  • Set best practices and change the workflow when needed so the team runs efficiently and meets company KPIs.
  • Take on ad hoc projects and step in wherever your team needs support.

What you’ll bring

  • At least 10 years of relevant mortgage experience, including 5 or more years directly managing a fully remote team
  • Experience managing mortgage loan processing and/or post-closing teams
  • A track record of coaching teams and helping them succeed
  • Working knowledge of federal, state, and local mortgage regulatory compliance
  • Strong written and virtual communication skills
  • You keep a distributed team aligned, engaged, and accountable using tools like Slack and video meetings
  • A strong focus on customer service. You go above and beyond to “wow” the people you serve.
  • Close attention to detail. You check your work carefully and catch the small things, so your work is consistently accurate.
  • A commitment to diverse, equitable, and inclusive practices that support Knock’s values of making an impact, learning, putting people first, being open, and being courageous
  • High school diploma or equivalent experience

Physical Requirements:

  • Set up and constantly operate a computer
  • Communicate and exchange accurate information to others via telephone or internet video applications

The candidate must be able to perform the essential functions of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation.

Our Compensation Philosophy: As a fully remote (U.S.-based) workforce, our goal is to ensure that all Knockstars are fairly compensated.  Please note that the salary range information that follows is a good faith estimate for this position provided pursuant to the Colorado Equal Pay for Equal Work Act for Colorado applicants.

Why Knock

Purpose-Driven Work: Your contributions will improve the homeownership journey for thousands of individuals and families.
Remote-First Flexibility: Work from anywhere in the U.S. with a flexible, people-first approach.
Innovative Culture: Collaborate with curious, talented colleagues in a supportive, growth-oriented environment. To learn more about the culture at Knock, view our POPSICLE values.

Enjoying Life & Making an Impact

jobs.title: Discord: Senior Stock Administrator
jobs.description:
Headquarters: San Francisco Bay Area or Remote (U.S.)

Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

Discord is where hundreds of millions of people come together around games, communities, and shared interests. Behind the scenes, our Stock Administration team makes sure every equity award — from a new hire's first grant to a multi-year vesting RSU release — is handled accurately, compliantly, and with care.

We're looking for an experienced Senior Stock Plan Administrator to join our team supporting the day-to-day administration of Discord's global equity programs, including equity grants, option exercises, RSU releases, and special projects. On any given day, you might be supporting the administration of equity grants, walking an employee through their vesting schedule, or partnering with our auditors to test a SOX control. You will partner with key stakeholders in our Finance, Payroll, Tax, Legal, and HR teams to answer employee inquiries, educate employees on equity programs, improve processes, implement controls, and provide reporting as needed. You will also work directly with external auditors and third-party vendors. This position will report directly to the Senior Manager, Stock Administration.

What you'll be doing:

  • Manage the daily administration of Discord's global equity plans — from participant eligibility and enrollment through award processing, exercises, settlements, tax withholding, mobility reporting, expirations, cancellations, repurchases, and terminations.
  • Process, validate, and reconcile equity transactions across equity administration platforms, payroll, and the general ledger, ensuring data integrity, accuracy, and timely resolution of discrepancies.
  • Partner with Legal, HR, Payroll, Tax, and Finance to administer Discord's global equity programs and support ongoing processes that ensure accurate record-keeping, withholding, reporting, and reconciliation across all equity data.
  • Maintain complete and reliable participant mobility data by tracking work locations and mobility history, and reconciling records across payroll and HRIS systems.
  • Provide a high level of service to employees, management, and stakeholders on equity plan questions; design and deliver educational sessions and communications about Discord's equity programs.
  • Manage the quarterly calendar of stock administration activities and prepare year-end tax information for IRC 6039 reporting.
  • Ensure SOX compliance across all aspects of the equity plan — including documentation, testing, and audit support — and ensure all equity compensation is administered per plan terms and conditions.

What you should have:

  • 5+ years in stock plan administration, with experience at both a private and public company.
  • Experience with global equity plans and managing an equity administration system.
  • A passion for equity and helping employees understand their equity compensation.
  • Detail-oriented with a high degree of accuracy.

Bonus points:

  • Certified Equity Professional (CEP) designation.
  • Experience with Carta.

This position is US-based and can be remote but if you live in the Bay Area, you're welcome to work from our beautiful SF office.

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

In this role, you will drive technical vision and strategy for ads data engineering in support of our ML initiatives while building and maintaining sophisticated data pipelines, datasets, and analytical tools. This role works heavily with Data Science, Machine Learning, and product. If leading technical innovation, architecting scalable solutions, and empowering teams through data excites you, we encourage you to make a move!

jobs.title: Carrot: Medical Expert, Fertility (Contractor)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is looking for a Fertility Medical Expert (RN, NP, or PA) to join our Medical Experts team on a contract basis for approximately a 3-month engagement, working a minimum 15 hours per week in a fully remote role. In this role, you will serve as a clinical resource for members navigating fertility and family-building, providing evidence-informed information and guidance that helps people understand their options and make confident, informed choices.

Day to day, you will meet with members by video to talk through their fertility questions and goals, offering clear, practical information without diagnosing, prescribing, or directing care..

This is a chance to put your fertility experience to work in a fast-growing digital health environment, with the flexibility of a contract schedule. You will work alongside a diverse team of medical experts across fertility, pregnancy, urology, mental health, and nutrition who share a passion for continuous learning and an evidence-based approach.

 

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Provide members with evidence-informed information and guidance on fertility topics, such as fertility evaluation and testing, treatment options, and family-building pathways
  • Conduct one-on-one virtual sessions (video) that educate and present options without diagnosing, prescribing, or directing care
  • Stay current on reproductive and fertility regulatory trends and clinical practice guidelines in the US
  • Participate in quality assurance initiatives and audits to help ensure a safe, compliant member experience that meets the highest standards
  • Collaborate with the broader Medical Experts team and cross-functional partners to deliver a consistent, high-quality member experience
  • Maintain a reliable, flexible schedule within ~15 hours per week range to meet member demand throughout the engagement

 

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 Days, you will have:

  • Delivered consistently high-quality, well-rated fertility sessions that help members feel informed and supported
  • Stayed within Carrot’s non-diagnostic, non-directive scope of practice and met documentation and quality standards across member interactions
  • Met your agreed weekly hours and availability, communicating proactively about scheduling and capacity
  • Ramped up quickly and worked independently with minimal oversight in a confidential, remote environment
  • Built trusted working relationships with the Medical Experts team and cross-functional partners

 

About You

You likely have:

  • An active US license as a Registered Nurse (RN), Nurse Practitioner (NP), or Physician Assistant (PA)
  • 3+ years of experience providing patient care in a fertility clinic or a hospital clinic that addresses reproductive health
  • Superb listening skills and the ability to empathetically discuss fertility and family-building topics
  • The ability to work independently and to distinguish good clinical judgment from non-directive guidance
  • The ability to work from a confidential and private remote environment with reliable internet and digital resources
  • Flexibility to adapt to evolving business needs and availability for 15 per week for a 3-month engagement

 

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in third-party reproduction (e.g., gestational surrogacy, donor gametes), urology, pregnancy, or menopause
  • Experience in digital health or telehealth settings, including virtual member or patient education
  • Prior contract or consulting experience with a quick ramp-up
  • Fluency in an additional language

 

Why This Role Matters

Fertility journeys are deeply personal, and members often arrive with more questions than answers. As a Fertility Medical Expert, you will be the knowledgeable, compassionate clinical voice who helps them understand their options and feel prepared for the conversations they have with their own care teams.

Your expertise helps make Carrot’s clinical program one that members trust and rely on, and it strengthens the confidence of the employers and health plans who count on Carrot to deliver high-quality, whole-person care. Even in a focused 3-month engagement, your work will make a direct, visible difference for the people we serve.

 

Interview Process

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

  • Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes
  • Hiring Manager Interview — 30–45 minutes
  • Mock Chat- 45 Minutes 

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

 

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

 

Compensation

 The starting base hourly for this position will range from $70-$90/hr. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

 

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

 

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.



Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

Our intelligent, cloud identity platform lets people shop, work, bank, and interact wherever and however they want. Without friction. Without fear.

We're headquartered in Denver, Colorado and we have offices and employees around the globe. We serve the largest, most demanding enterprises worldwide, including more than half of the Fortune 100. jobs.title: Current: Freelance Marketo Email Engineer
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote (US)

 

About the Role

As a Freelance Marketo Email Specialist, you'll build, test, and launch email programs in Marketo for a range of client brands. This is a hands-on, execution-only contract role with no leadership or management responsibilities. You'll take approved briefs and turn them into working programs, building responsive templates and modules, setting up smart lists and flows, and making sure every send goes out right the first time. You know Marketo well enough to spot a broken token, a misfired trigger, or a segmentation gap before it reaches a subscriber. You'll take direction from our internal team, get up to speed fast, and deliver accurate builds on schedule with minimal oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and launch email programs in Marketo, including one-off sends, nurture streams, engagement programs, and triggered campaigns.
  • Develop and maintain responsive email templates and modular components in HTML and CSS, using Marketo's template syntax, variables, and editable sections.
  • Set up smart lists, smart campaigns, flow steps, and segmentations that match the targeting and logic in the brief.
  • Use tokens, dynamic content, and snippets to personalize emails and keep programs easy to clone and reuse.
  • QA every email before launch: rendering across clients and devices (e.g. Litmus or Email on Acid), links, tokens, personalization fallbacks, and list logic.
  • Manage program structure, naming conventions, and folder organization so client instances stay clean and easy to navigate.
  • Build to the brief and requirements provided, and flag any gaps or errors in the request before they become problems in the send.
  • Communicate status, timelines, and blockers clearly with your internal point of contact.
  • Document builds and processes so other team members can pick up, update, or reuse the work.
  • Follow established Marketo, deliverability, and accessibility standards on every build.

Qualifications

Required

  • At least 3 years of hands-on experience building and deploying email campaigns in Marketo Engage.
  • Strong working knowledge of Marketo programs, smart lists, smart campaigns, tokens, snippets, and dynamic content.
  • Proficiency in HTML and CSS for email, including responsive and hybrid coding and Marketo template syntax.
  • Experience with email rendering and QA tools such as Litmus or Email on Acid.
  • A detail-oriented QA process that catches errors in logic, links, and personalization before launch.
  • Experience working across multiple clients or Marketo instances, adapting quickly to different setups and conventions.
  • Clear, proactive communication, including flagging risks early and giving accurate time estimates.
  • Ability to work independently, take direction well, and hit deadlines across overlapping requests.

Preferred

  • Marketo Certified Expert or Marketo Certified Associate.
  • Familiarity with email deliverability, authentication (SPF, DKIM, DMARC), and list hygiene.
  • Experience with email accessibility standards (e.g. WCAG).
  • Experience with lead scoring, lifecycle programs, and Marketo–Salesforce CRM sync.
  • Experience with other marketing automation platforms (e.g. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, HubSpot, Braze).
  • Agency or consulting experience.

Why Current

At Current, we believe the best digital work happens when strategy, design, production, and technology operate as one team. We partner with ambitious brands to create digital experiences that are thoughtful, scalable, and built to drive real impact.

We're a remote-first agency with teams across the US, working collaboratively across websites, platforms, campaigns, CRM ecosystems, and digital product experiences. Our environment is fast-paced, highly collaborative, and built for people who enjoy solving complex technical challenges alongside smart, supportive teammates.

You'll have the opportunity to work across a variety of clients and technologies, and contribute to meaningful digital experiences within a growing agency environment.

This is a freelance, contract engagement. The target hourly rate for this role is $50 - $70 per hour. Actual rate is influenced by a wide array of factors, including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, and location.

jobs.title: Socure: Technical Content Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Headquarters:
URL: https://www.socure.com/

About the role

This is an employment marketing role for someone who can make exceptional engineers want to work at Socure. Socure is building AI-native infrastructure for identity, fraud prevention, and trust, and we need your help getting that engineering story out to the places where great technical talent discovers ideas, follows builders, and finds its next challenge.

You will work closely with engineers, technical leaders, recruiting, and marketing to turn APIs, machine learning models, identity graphs, and decisioning workflows into a compelling case for joining the team. Your work will show software engineers the problems they can solve here, the systems they can help build, and the ambition behind Socure's mission.

Why this role matters

The best engineers are not looking for generic employer branding. They are looking for hard technical problems, strong peers, meaningful architecture, and a mission worth their time. You will make those things visible - in the communities, publications, developer platforms, social channels, and other talent-rich spaces where engineers actually pay attention.

What you will do

Tell the engineering story

  • Interview engineers and technical leaders, learn how the platform works, and turn real technical work into stories that make top engineers lean in.

  • Write technical content - including engineering blogs, deep dives, architecture stories, technical whitepapers, and recruiting-facing website copy - that makes the work at Socure tangible.

Reach engineers where they are

  • Own an employment-marketing content calendar built around the channels and communities where software engineers discover work, exchange ideas, and decide which companies deserve their attention.

  • Adapt and distribute stories across developer platforms, technical publications, engineering communities, social channels, and other high-signal places where the best talent gathers.

  • Partner with recruiting and employer brand to connect content to talent goals, strengthen candidate interest, and support hard-to-fill engineering hiring.

Make difficult technology compelling

  • Translate APIs, machine learning models, identity graphs, decisioning workflows, and cloud-based architectures into accurate, engaging stories for technical audiences.

  • Show why the problems matter, what makes Socure's approach distinctive, and what an engineer could help build next.

Build real subject matter depth

  • Develop enough understanding of Socure's products and platform to write with authority, ask sharp questions, and earn the trust of technical experts.

  • Stay current on AI, fraud, identity, security, and infrastructure trends, and turn them into timely points of view that attract the right people.

How you will work

Collaborate across the company

  • Work with engineering, recruiting, employer brand, product marketing, and technical subject matter experts to find the strongest stories and get them ready for the right audiences.

  • Partner with design, social, and distribution teams to package and place content for reach, credibility, and candidate action.

  • Build a repeatable feedback loop with engineers so the content stays technically honest and genuinely representative of the work.

Raise the bar

  • Protect a high editorial standard for clarity, accuracy, voice, and consistency across every channel.

  • Edit and proofread content from other contributors, and help maintain Socure's content style guide.

Use AI thoughtfully

  • Use AI tools such as ChatGPT's Deep Research to accelerate research, drafting, and technical enablement while keeping human judgment, verification, and editorial quality at the center.

What you bring

  • Demonstrable experience in content writing, technical writing, employer brand, recruiting marketing, or content marketing, ideally in identity verification, fraud, cybersecurity, fintech, infrastructure, or another technical B2B SaaS environment.

  • Strong technical curiosity and the ability to learn and write accurately about APIs, machine learning, and cloud-based architectures.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with a talent for making complex technical work clear, credible, and exciting to software engineers.

  • A portfolio of published technical, engineering, employer-brand, or recruiting content, such as blogs, deep dives, whitepapers, case studies, or similar work.

  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with engineering, recruiting, employer brand, product marketing, and subject matter experts.

  • Strong editorial and distribution instincts, with comfort owning a content calendar, finding the right audience and channel, giving and receiving feedback, and maintaining a consistent voice.

  • Experience using AI tools for research, drafting, and content production is a plus.

If you can understand ambitious engineering work, find the audience that will appreciate it, and make great engineers curious enough to start a conversation, we want to hear from you.

jobs.description:
Headquarters: Missouri, United States
URL: http://www.crowdstrike.com

As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

The Regional Principal Analyst is the most senior technical individual contributor within a Falcon Complete region, serving as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and their immediate leadership teams. This role provides hands-on technical leadership across multiple fireteams, supporting on complex incident response, conducting deep technical case review, identifying operations and product improvement opportunities, and driving technical quality across regional operations through various technical deliverables. The Regional Principal Analyst maintains deep, current expertise through regular hands-on engagement, and collaboration in complex service delivery scenarios.

What You'll Do:

Technical Leadership:

  • Serve as the principal technical advisor to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership Team on all Falcon Complete service delivery matters
  • Ensure technical consistency, quality standards, and best practices across regional operations
  • Lead regional technical initiatives
  • Coordinate with other Regional Principals to ensure global consistency and knowledge sharing

Technical Escalation Support:

  • Serve as a technical escalation resource for Fireteam Principal Analysts on complex or ambiguous cases, providing second opinion, additional analysis, and technical guidance, while assisting with Principal technical development
  • Fireteam Principal Analysts retain ownership and lead of high-severity incident response; the Regional Principal supports as a technical resource, and highlights opportunities to improve the Falcon Complete service and technical excellence of the region.
  • Perform independent technical analysis when asked to validate or extend a fireteam's findings

Operational Excellence & Quality Assurance:

  • Conduct technical QA reviews of closed cases across fireteams against defined criteria with documented findings
  • Identify detection gaps, false-positive patterns, and coverage opportunities from regional case data; route findings to relevant teams as improvement requests
  • Identify opportunities for tooling, telemetry, or workflow improvements based on recurring case patterns
  • Identify regional trends in detection patterns, threat landscape, and case quality
  • Identify skill gaps and development opportunities across the regional analyst population
  • Drive adoption of consistent operational standards and agentic toolsets across regional operations.

Cross-Functional Technical Liaison

  • Represent regional technical perspective in cross-functional initiatives with other CrowdStrike business units
  • Work directly with Product/Engineering to surface detection coverage gaps, platform bugs, and feature requests
  • Coordinate with OverWatch and Intelligence on regional threat trends
  • Partner with other Regional Principal Analysts on shared technical review standards and case QA criteria
  • Partner with Watchtower to drive detection tuning and coverage improvements based on regional intelligence.

Thought Leadership & Market Engagement

  • Demonstrate industry thought leadership through blog posts, CrowdCasts, conference presentations, and other speaking events as appropriate

Strategic Projects & Innovation

  • Provide Technical expertise on  regional projects that align with Falcon Complete mission and corporate goals
  • Drive innovation in detection gaps, triage, remediation, and automation capabilities
  • Collaborate with Section 3 (S3) AI Automation Team on regional automation opportunities
  • Identify and implement efficiency improvements with measurable regional impact

Supervision & Autonomy

  • Works under minimal direction with high degree of autonomy
  • Works independently on technical matters
  • Expected to remain hands-on
  • Determines and pursues courses of action essential to achieving regional and corporate objectives
  • Provides consultative guidance to Regional Directors and Senior Leadership

What You'll Need


Successful candidates will have extensive experience in multiple of the following areas:


  • Incident Handling: expert-level experience leading and managing complex incident response investigations, including the ability to take ownership of high-severity, multi-host, and multi-customer incidents from triage through remediation. Proven experience investigating host/user compromises, organized crime groups, and sophisticated nation-state adversaries.
  • Threat Landscape Awareness: deep expertise in attack vectors, threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs), with advanced proficiency applying and extending MITRE ATT&CK to drive detection improvements and investigation strategies.
  • Computer Forensic Analysis: advanced experience conducting forensic analysis across host, memory, and network artifacts using a broad toolkit to determine full scope and root cause of compromise.
  • Malware Analysis: advanced ability to perform static and dynamic malware analysis, including reverse engineering concepts and behavioral analysis.
  • Operating System Fundamentals: expert-level knowledge of Windows, Mac, and/or Linux operating systems, with particular depth in at least one of these areas.
  • Systems Administration: advanced experience administering and securing enterprise network environments, with strong knowledge of IT architecture, authentication systems, and common attack paths across infrastructure.
  • Network Analysis Fundamentals: expert-level knowledge of network protocols and traffic analysis, with the ability to identify attack patterns, lateral movement, and exfiltration in network data.
  • Identity Platform Awareness: deep expertise with identity and access management platforms such as Okta, Microsoft Entra ID, and Active Directory, including advanced knowledge of identity-based attack techniques and credential abuse patterns.
  • Email Security Awareness: advanced experience investigating and remediating Microsoft 365 security incidents, including sophisticated business email compromise (BEC) and adversary-in-the-middle (AITM) attack chains.
  • Third-Party Log Analysis: advanced proficiency querying and correlating log sources across cloud platforms, network devices, identity providers, and email platforms within a SIEM environment to build detection logic and drive complex investigations.
  • Incident Remediation: proven expertise developing and executing strategic and surgical remediation plans for compromised environments, including complex multi-host and multi-platform scenarios with third-party containment coordination.
  • Network Operations and Architecture/Engineering: expert-level understanding of secure network architecture with advanced hands-on experience navigating and troubleshooting enterprise network environments to support complex incident investigations.
  • Programming/Scripting: experience developing scripts and automation using Python, PowerShell, or Bash to build investigative tooling, automate remediation workflows, and expand detection and response capabilities.
  • AI Platforms: Experience working across various AI models, platforms, and tooling including MCP servers and agentic frameworks. Applies AI broadly across security operations — from investigation acceleration and workflow automation to internal capability development, prompt engineering, and driving AI adoption and maturity across the team.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

Education:
BA or BS / MA or MS degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Math, Information Security, Information Assurance, Information Security Management, Intelligence Studies, Cybersecurity, Cybersecurity Policy, or a related field. Applicants without a degree but with relevant work experience and/or training will be considered.

Why AssemblyAI

AssemblyAI builds the best-in-class Voice AI models powering the next generation of voice applications. We have a lab, and we also power our own models in our own proprietary inference environment. The Voice AI space is at an inflection point; we’re looking for the best talent we can find to join a rapidly scaling team that's defining the future of the industry.

We are one of the most capital-efficient AI companies on the planet - and are rapidly approaching $1M ARR per employee. We sit among the top 5 most revenue-dense teams within the fastest-growing AI companies today. We have thousands of customers building with us including the top startups and world-renowned enterprises, and are serving at tremendous scale: we process nearly 2 million hours of audio daily and handle more than 15 million API calls every day. This is a rare growth-stage opportunity where the business is proven, the revenue is durable, and the growth trajectory is steep and getting steeper. We have a super flat culture and expect our employees to be deeply intimate with the details at all levels.

If you've ever felt buried under layers of bureaucracy, starved of real ownership, or frustrated watching your work disappear into a slow-moving org, AssemblyAI is built differently. The company operates as a true meritocracy, with no heavy planning or approval processes and no gatekeeping on the tools or information you need. AssemblyAI builds the foundational speech models behind the Voice AI products our customers build. The people who train those models and build the systems that serve them are some of the hardest people in tech to hire; and we need to hire a lot more of them in 2027.

The Director of Co-Manufacturing & Procurement is responsible for overseeing Glossier’s purchasing strategy, vendor relationships, and supply chain operations to acquire goods and services cost-effectively. The Director of Co-Manufacturing & Procurement is both strategic and hands-on, with a direct impact on customer satisfaction, margin protection and commercial flexibility. This role works closely with finance, logistics, and commercial as a trusted, strategic partner enabling value and flexibility to support broader business goals. 

You will be responsible for all processes and budget with expectations for delivering both short-term and long-term priorities and plans. The right person needs to be a driven yet compassionate leader with the proven ability to successfully motivate, mentor and develop a team to represent Operational Excellence across the Glossier brand. You will work closely with our internal teams to lead and develop a first-class supply chain that supports Glossier’s growth and expansion, both domestically and internationally. Omni-channel beauty industry experience is preferred with a preference for candidates who have previously worked in fragrance, make-up and/or skincare.

  • Strategic Procurement Planning: Develop and implement procurement plans to support new development and existing portfolio products, ensuring finished goods meet operational and financial goals.
  • Continuous Improvement & Process Excellence: Drive continuous improvement initiatives within the procurement function to enhance efficiency and reduce costs, lead times, and MOQs.
  • Supplier Network Strategy & Qualification: Identify and qualify new suppliers, establishing new vendor partnerships while maintaining current vendor connectivity rooted in quality, transparency, and efficiency.
  • Material Replenishment Strategy: Lead efforts to develop, implement, and manage alternate material replenishment methods that increase inventory turns year over year while supporting 100% customer on-time delivery and lead-time reduction.
  • Risk Management & Market Intelligence: Monitor market trends, supplier performance, and economic conditions to proactively mitigate supply chain risks.
  • Contract Negotiation & Terms: Lead negotiations with suppliers to secure favorable pricing, terms, and conditions for goods and services.

  • Supplier Quality & Corrective Action: Monitor supplier scrap rates, obtain corrective actions to reduce supplier-generated scrap in a timely manner, and oversee the resolution of all issues affecting product quality or on-time delivery.
  • Order Tracking & Expediting: Coordinate and track open order updates across all vendor partners to remain informed of delays or potential shipment issues.
  • Day-to-Day Administration & Master Data: Manage PO execution, master data accuracy, BOM creation/management, supplier records, and spend tracking.

KEY INGREDIENTS

  • 10+ Years of Global Supply Chain Leadership
    • Deep expertise leading end-to-end global supply chain, procurement, sourcing, and quality operations in an omni-channel environment.

    • Hands-on experience scaling operations using ERP, WMS, and e-commerce platforms to drive efficiency.

And in the spirit of how we are Customer Inspired — where every decision has a true north, and it's our customer — you'll administer access and configuration as the security controls they are, protecting the company and the data customers trust us with.

We are seeking a Salesforce CRM, and related customer experience systems, expert. Someone that can see the big picture, future state but has a keen eye for details. jobs.title: Carrot: Telemedicine Registered Nurse (RN), Consultant
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Remote

About Carrot:

Carrot is the leading global fertility and family care platform, built on intelligent care orchestration: the right clinical guidance, at the right moment, in the context of each member’s life. More than a thousand multinational employers, health plans, and health systems trust Carrot to support millions of members across 195 countries – from pre-pregnancy through menopause and major life moments in between. Carrot's comprehensive clinical program delivers industry-leading cost savings for plan sponsors and award-winning experiences and improved outcomes for millions of people worldwide.

Carrot is widely regarded as a defining force in healthcare innovation as a recipient of several top-tier awards, including Fast Company's 'Most Innovative Companies' and CNBC's '100 Barrier Breaking Startups'. The company is regularly cited by leading global outlets — including The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, NPR, ABC News, and Harvard Business Review — as a leading voice on digital health, the future of work, and family health. Learn more at get-carrot.com.

The Opportunity

Carrot is expanding its telemedicine clinic with a network of part-time to full-time, fully remote Registered Nurses who deliver evidence-based virtual care to members across all U.S. states. As an RN in this network, you are often the first clinical touchpoint for members navigating fertility, menopause, hormonal, and metabolic health journeys, providing triage, education, care coordination, and documentation that shape the entire care experience.

All work in this role is performed within RN scope of practice. RNs provide triage, education, care coordination, and documentation; they do not diagnose, do not prescribe, and do not independently modify a treatment plan. Anything requiring clinical judgment beyond RN scope is routed to a physician, so sound escalation judgment is central to the role.

This is a contractor engagement of approximately 20-40 hours per week, with scheduled shifts within the Monday-Friday, 8:00a-6:00p CST coverage window. 

What You’ll Own

In this role, you will:

  • Serve as the first clinical reviewer of inbound member messages, triaging for urgency, escalating to a physician when needed, and routing non-clinical threads to the appropriate support team.
  • Deliver member education on menopause staging, hormone therapy, preconception health, metabolic health, and medication administration.
  • Review and triage incoming lab results, escalate critical findings per protocol, retrieve outside records, and coordinate specialist referrals.
  • Manage pharmacy callbacks and prior authorizations in coordination with the care team.
  • Document all clinically relevant interactions same-day, create tracked internal tasks with named owners, and follow established escalation pathways.
  • Maintain active NLC multi-state licensure, complete required credentialing and onboarding, and adhere to HIPAA, continuing education, and liability coverage requirements.
  • Contribute to chart audits and clinical protocol feedback as the telemedicine program scales.

What Success Looks Like  

In your first 12–18 months, you will have:

  • Established a consistent record of accurate, protocol-aligned triage with appropriate physician escalation and no missed critical lab values.
  • Maintained same-day documentation and timely lab follow-up, with no outstanding credentialing or compliance gaps.
  • Delivered high-quality member education across menopause, preconception, hormone therapy, and metabolic health topics, reflected in strong member experience results.
  • Managed care coordination workflows reliably within your coverage window, including referrals, records retrieval, prior authorizations, and pharmacy callbacks.
  • Contributed to chart audits, protocol feedback, and quality improvement as the telemedicine program scales.

About You

You likely have:

  • An active, unrestricted RN license with NLC (Nurse Licensure Compact) multi-state privileges, in good standing, plus an ADN or BSN from an accredited program (BSN preferred).
  • A minimum of 3 years of active RN clinical experience, with meaningful experience in women's health, reproductive health, OB/GYN, fertility, endocrinology, Urology, Mens Health, or menopause care.
  • Demonstrated nurse triage experience, including assessing urgency, applying protocol, escalating appropriately, and recognizing critical lab values.
  • A clear understanding of RN scope of practice and sound judgment about when to escalate.
  • Strong written communication for asynchronous messaging and a strong phone presence for symptom assessment and instruction.
  • Proficiency with EHR and telehealth systems, secure messaging, and e-fax workflows.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA and applicable telemedicine privacy, security, and regulatory requirements.
  • The ability to commit to scheduled shifts within the Monday-Friday, 8:00a-6:00p CST coverage window, with a HIPAA-compliant, private home workspace and reliable internet.

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

  • Experience in a dedicated menopause clinic, fertility center, REI practice, or comparable specialty program.
  • Familiarity with preconception and fertility workup, including AMH and hormone panels, ovulation tracking, and cycle-monitoring labs.
  • Hormone therapy education experience, including prior authorization workflows.
  • Experience supporting members on anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists.
  • Prior experience in digital health, health benefits, or multi-state telemedicine environments.
  • Experience contributing to clinical protocol development, quality improvement, or member-facing clinical content.
  • Experience supporting diverse and historically underserved populations, including LGBTQ+ and gender-diverse individuals.
  • Relevant certification (e.g., MSCP through The Menopause Society, RNC-OB) and/or fluency in an additional language.

 

Why This Role Matters

Carrot's RN network is the front line of the telemedicine clinic. RNs are typically the first clinician a member reaches, and the quality of their triage judgment, education, and follow-through directly determines member safety, trust, and the experience of care during some of the most personal moments of members' lives.

This role also keeps the clinical program running well as it scales. Reliable triage, same-day documentation, and disciplined escalation protect physician capacity for the decisions that require it, while expanding access to guideline-aligned fertility, menopause, and metabolic health support for members who often cannot find it locally.

Why Candidates Join Carrot

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

  • A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.
  • A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.
  • Flexible Time Off and a culture that actively encourages employees to recharge.
  • Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.
  • A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.
  • The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation: 

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will range from $40-$50/ hr. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience. 

 

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

 

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. Carrot is regularly featured in media reporting on issues related to the future of work, women in leadership, and healthcare innovation, including MSNBC, The Economist, Bloomberg, The Wall Street Journal, CNBC, National Public Radio, Harvard Business Review, and more. Learn more at carrotfertility.com.

Metabolic health is a core, cross-cutting component of this program. You should expect metabolic assessment and management to be a routine part of your visits, and clinicians comfortable prescribing and managing anti-obesity medications, including GLP-1 receptor agonists, within clinical protocols are especially encouraged to apply.

  • Familiarity with ACOG, ASRM, and The Menopause Society guidelines.
  • Prior telemedicine experience (preferred), with comfort managing visits entirely in a virtual environment and a strong virtual presence that supports shared decision-making over video and phone.

Nice to Have ⭐

As Lead Product Manager of the Narrative Editing team, you'll own how users capture, edit, and perfect their stories. You'll shape the script-first editing that makes video as simple as a document, the recording and writing tools that let users create without leaving Descript, and the AI regeneration features that make edits feel seamless and natural.

This is an opportunity to shape features that professional creators depend on while working with cutting-edge AI, a product users love, and a small, collaborative team where your impact is immediate and visible.

  • Develop a deep understanding of our customers, their creative goals, and the evolving AI video landscape — and use those insights to guide the editor roadmap

  • Continuously expand our editing capabilities with frontier AI technology by partnering with our AI Research team, launching features like video regeneration and automatic speaker identification
  • Own the recording, script generation, and translation flows that help users achieve their end-to-end video workflows directly in Descript
  • Ensure Descript scales reliably for larger teams and more complex workflows

Who you are

  • You’ve built deceptively powerful tools: You have 5 or more years of product management experience shipping creative tools or workflow products that feel simple enough for everyone, but scale to handle sophisticated use cases. You are a systems-minded product thinker who excels at designing intuitive experiences for complex, end-to-end workflows.
  • You start with the customer: Plenty of “AI products” start with the technology and they all suck. You care deeply about understanding customers, and have experience in doing customer discovery and defining features that solve real problems.
  • You are a fog sculptor: There are aspects to our editor and its design that do not have real competitors yet. The product intuition and design conventions have not been decided. You are attracted to ambiguous problems, know how to ask smart questions, and translate ideas into action.
  • You care about craft: Our product is not a hype machine that runs on empty promises and vaporware. We think our product will be successful because people love to use it. That means you sweat the details. But without the sweat, because you aren’t stressed out.
  • You are funny, creative, maybe kind of weird: Ok, this isn’t a hard requirement but Descript is kind of a quirky place and the people who love it tend to like that about working here. So, just want to drop a hint early on. Also, the sense of humor is important because even though we take our work seriously it’s still just, like, video creation and editing. About Descript

Descript is building a simple, intuitive, fully-powered editing tool for video and audio — an editing tool built for the age of AI. We are a team of 150 and the backing of some of the world's greatest investors (OpenAI, Andreessen Horowitz, Redpoint Ventures, Spark Capital).

Benefits include a generous healthcare package, 401k matching program, catered lunches, and flexible vacation time. Our headquarters are located in the Mission District of San Francisco, CA. We're hiring for a mix of remote roles and hybrid roles.  For those who are remote, we have a handful of opportunities throughout the year for in person collaboration.  For our hybrid roles, we're flexible, and you're an adult—we don't expect or mandate that you're in the office every day. As the first point of contact for employees and managers, coordinators deliver high-volume, high-accuracy service across HR transactions, data, leave, employee relations support, and employee questions, creating a consistently excellent employee experience. They partner closely with People Business Partners, keeping the work moving, the data clean, and the PBP fully informed, and work alongside Total Rewards, Benefits and Mobility, and Talent Acquisition so programs run smoothly.

Each coordinator also serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing local compliance knowledge, language, and time zone coverage to the team. Working within a shared services model, coordinators cover for one another across functions during peak periods and absences, and bring back improvements that strengthen the whole team. This is a broad, high-visibility role and a clear path toward People Business Partner or People Operations leadership.

About 60 - 70% of your time supports your assigned business function(s) and their People Business Partner. That includes lifecycle transactions, employee data, questions, ER support, and the people programs for your pod.

The remaining 30–40% supports the broader People team. You will help Total Rewards with compensation and benefits cycles, partner with People Systems on HiBob, data, and reporting, and support Talent Acquisition through the handoff from offer to onboarding. You’ll also serve as the expert for your assigned country and cover for teammates during peak periods.

The balance shifts with the business calendar. Expect more Total Rewards work during open enrollment and compensation cycles, for example. We review it regularly throughout the year.

This role begins as a three-month contract with the opportunity to convert to a full-time, permanent Salesloft position based on business needs and performance. The contract period gives you the chance to learn the team, the systems and the business function you support, and gives us the chance to work together before making a long-term commitment. We will check in with you along the way so you know how things are going.

On a day-to-day basis, you will:

  • Lifecycle Administration. Manages the employee lifecycle for the assigned business function, from offer through exit. Prepares offer letters, coordinates background checks and I-9 and right-to-work verification, and runs onboarding and offboarding, including exit surveys, so every transition is accurate and on time.
  • Employee Data & Records. Maintains accurate employee data in HiBob and ADP for the assigned business function. Processes hires, changes, promotions, transfers, terminations, and org updates, and audits records and personnel files to keep data clean and audit-ready.
  • HR Case Management. Serves as the first point of contact for employee and manager questions through people@ and HappyFox. Resolves routine requests promptly and escalates complex or sensitive issues to People Business Partners and specialists.
  • Mobility, & Benefits Support. Serves as the first point of contact for benefits questions and partners closely with the Benefits and Mobility Specialist to keep PBPs informed on mobility cases.
  • PBP, ER & Programs Support.
    • PBP Partnership & Employee Relations Support. Partners with the assigned People Business Partner through weekly syncs, sharing context so they have full visibility without having to ask. Supports ER cases under PBP direction by maintaining documentation and the ER tracker, coordinating investigation logistics, and preparing PIP and termination paperwork.
    • Program administration: Project manages the promotion process for the assigned business function, tracking and documenting each promotion through processing. Supports compensation cycle execution and submits roles for compensation analysis, following up with leaders and tracking turnaround.
    • Survey, QBR & Talent Support. Manages the engagement survey in the system and compiles data and pre-reads for leadership reviews. Supports the QBR process and prepares data and insights for talent calibration conversations.
  • Reporting, Analytics & Compliance Support. Fulfills data requests and runs standard reports and headcount reconciliations, providing analysis that supports business reviews and People programs. Supports audits, country-specific filings, I-9 compliance, record retention, and policy acknowledgments, and manages vendor invoices.
  • Process Improvement. Establishes and maintains SOPs so the team delivers consistent service across pods. Flags recurring case themes and tests HRIS and workflow changes, turning patterns from the assigned business function into improvements for the whole team.
  • Country Expertise.  Serves as the expert for an assigned country, bringing knowledge of local employment practices and compliance requirements, along with language and time zone coverage. Reviews country-specific documents prepared by other coordinators, supports local filings and vendor relationships, and keeps the team current on changes in local requirements.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

We are looking for a service-minded, detail-obsessed People professional who takes pride in getting the work right the first time. You understand that every offer letter, record update, and employee question is someone’s experience of the company, and you treat each one that way. You are comfortable being the first point of contact for employees and managers, and you know when to resolve a request yourself and when to bring in a People Business Partner or specialist. You handle confidential information with discretion and communicate clearly in writing. You are equally at home working through a high volume of transactions and spotting the pattern behind them, and you bring ideas back that make the whole team better. You enjoy partnering with business leaders, adapt easily across time zones and cultures, and want to build toward a career as a People Business Partner or in People Operations leadership.

THE TEAM:

Our People Operations Coordinators, PBPs and specialists work as one team on a shared goal, and each role has clear ownership. Coordinators are the front door of the People organization: warm, responsive and exact, with the pride in getting it right that earns managers’ and employees’ trust. We are a global team across India, Mexico and the United States, we cover for one another, and we share what we learn so every pod gets better. We take on hard problems together, and we hold ourselves to a high bar for accountability, empathy and execution.Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired

Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer-Inspired

THE SKILL SET:

  • Hands-on HRIS experience  and a case management tool (JIRA, happy fox, service now, etc.)
  • Strong attention to detail, discretion with confidential data, and clear written communication
  • Comfort supporting business leaders and managers, and working across time zones and cultures

jobs.title: Wrike: CloudOps Engineer (Network Engineer)
jobs.description:
Headquarters: Cyprus - Remote

Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.
 
Wrike is our people, not a place. As a distributed team, we own our growth, stay globally connected, and rely on the product we build to deliver impactful work alongside brilliant minds. You'll have real ownership over meaningful work, a global team that has your back, and the flexibility to do your best work your way. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.
 
Our vision:  A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together. 
 

About the Role:

As a CloudOps Engineer at Wrike, you have advanced skills in supporting cloud and on-prem data center infrastructure with security in mind. You know how to work with containers, networking, monitoring, automation, and debugging a reasonably complex infrastructure. You feel comfortable defining your own work based on the team OKRs. You can also help others do so when necessary. You are used to proposing meaningful improvements to the existing infrastructure in alignment with architects and tech leads, and you can drive the execution

In this specific role, you will take ownership of the design, implementation, and lifecycle management of our Network Infrastructure across hybrid environments. You bring deep, hands-on expertise in architecting resilient network topologies, configuring core routing and switching, managing firewalls, and securing connectivity between cloud providers and on-premise data centers.

Your Impact: 

  • Keep our infrastructure and company information safe with reliable network security
  • Keep our services running smoothly and fast for users around the clock
  • Managing the Wrike product infrastructure
  • Implementing reliable solutions to ensure a product uptime SLA of 99.9%
  • Working with GCP, AWS and other cloud providers in the IaC paradigm
  • Introducing and supporting new infrastructure services
  • Actively participating in incident response and management, including on-call duties
  • Developing and maintaining professional connections within and outside of the team

Your Qualifications: 

  • Juniper/Cisco devices underlying network infra
  • Kubernetes and ArgoCD
  • Nginx, HAproxy and Istio for load balancing
  • GCP, AWS and Cloudflare are our main cloud providers
  • Puppet, Ansible and Terraform for defining everything as a code
  • Python to automate everything
  • Prometheus (VictoriaMetrics) and Zabbix for monitoring
  • Graylog, Logstash, Fluentd for logging
  • Jenkins and Gitlab-CI for building pipelines
  • Upper Intermediate English skills

Standout Qualities: 

  • Experience with working with enterprise-grade infrastructure and SaaS solutions
  • Profound knowledge of network technologies, data transmission protocols, network architecture, and equipment
  • Experience working with BGP, OSPF, EVPN, STP, IPsec protocols
  • Familiarity with Linux, iptables, Nginx, HAproxy, and keepalive
  • Understanding of information security principles and the ability to apply them to network architecture
  • Sufficient scripting skills in Python/Bash or other scripting languages
  • Strong analytical abilities and problem-solving skills

Team Dynamics: 

  • Your manager will be Dmitrii Vlasov, SysOps Team Lead 
  • We have two dozen folks in the SysOps Department, consisting of four teams distributed in Prague, Nicosia, Rennes and Tallinn

Our Work Style:

  • Scrum based processes (daily standups, biweekly plannings, quarterly plannings)
  • Hybrid mode (1-2 days per week)
  • On-call shifts in production and development environments

What’s Next?

  • Introduction Call with a Recruiter
  • Technical interview
  • Cultural interview

Benefits & Perks:

  • 25 calendar days of paid vacation
  • Sick Leave Compensation (5 Paid Uncertified Sick Days)
  • Parental Leave: 18 Weeks Maternity / 4 Week Paternity 
  • 2 Volunteer Days
  • Medical Insurance (Employees + Dependents)
  • Hybrid Working Model
  • School Allowance (Up to €600/month for school aged kids)
  • Simcard w/ Unlimited Internet Access for active employees
  • Office Lunch Allowance (via Wolt) on Wednesdays / Thursdays

Your recruitment buddy will be Alexandra Vorobyova, Lead Recruiter.


#LI-AV1

Who Is Wrike and Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.
 
Hybrid work mode

Wrike is our people, not a place. With 1,000+ employees collaborating across nearly every time zone, we support talent through 10 global hubs — Australia, Costa Rica, Cyprus, Czechia, Estonia, France, India, Ireland, Japan, and the United States — offering flexible ways of working that include remote work, hybrid environments, and co-working spaces across many locations.
 
While flexibility looks different across teams and regions, employees located near certain hubs — particularly in Prague (CZ), Nicosia (CY), Bangalore (IN), and Rennes (FR) — are generally expected to collaborate in person around 2–3 days per week, balancing the flexibility of distributed work with opportunities for in-person collaboration and connection.

Our persona

  Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!
  Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful. 

Our culture and Values 

Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions. 

Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

 
Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.
