jobs.description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

About The Role

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle to own measurement and experimentation for how new customers activate and existing ones stay.The metrics are yours whatever the lever: CRM campaigns, promos and incentives, onboarding changes in the product, and a next best action layer that decides what each customer should see next. You decide what we test, how we test it and what we do with the answer. You also bring your own hypotheses on where the next win is.

 


What You'll Do

What you'll do

Join activation and retention initiatives before anything is built, whether they come from CRM, growth or product. Define the primary metric, check against historical data whether the effect is detectable at our volumes, and turn solution-shaped requests into problem-shaped ones.

Design and analyse experiments end to end: hypothesis, guardrails, audience split, MDE and power, stopping rule, and a readout that ends in ship, iterate or kill. 

Correct for channel and engagement bias (not everyone opens email, and open and click populations are self-selected). When a clean A/B is impossible, use causal inference: diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control or geo designs.

Bring hypotheses of your own. Launch a few new experiments across onboarding and the customer lifecycle, and turn one-off wins into recurring segmented flows.

Build deliberately simple models: segmentation, propensity, churn and dormancy scoring. They feed audiences, personalisation and incentive targeting. Over time these come together into next best action: for a given customer, which offer, feature nudge or message to send next, through which channel, and whether to send anything at all. You own the logic and the measurement of whether it beats the current rules.

Automate your own recurring work: audience refresh jobs, readout templates, dashboards for Activation, Onboarding and Retention. Ship models the Databricks way (scheduled jobs write tables, tables map into downstream tools such as Braze) and bring engagement data back into the warehouse to close the loop.


What You Bring

What you bring

  • Strong SQL and Python, and a Git-based warehouse workflow with code review.

  • Experiment design, statistics and metric design you can defend.

  • BI experience, Power BI/Tableau or similar.

  • Stakeholder management and business sense: you can push back, reframe a request and land a recommendation with a non-technical audience.

  • Curiosity and ownership. You run your area without waiting to be asked.

    •  


    Nice To Have

    Nice to have

  • Causal inference methods and a clear sense of when each one is valid.

  • Clustering and segmentation that ends up in use, not in a slide.

  • Predictive modelling with honest validation. Uplift modelling is a plus.

  • Braze or a comparable CRM platform: audiences, canvases, native split testing, channel mechanics and their biases.

    • What You Will Get In Return
     
    Make a genuine impact on the product
     
    Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
     
    Work in the EU
     
    Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
     
    Become a stock options holder
     
    Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
     
    Receive unwavering support and care
     
    Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
     
    Work & Swim program
     
    Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
     
    Equal Opportunity Statement 
     
    At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Innovative Project Planner (Data Centres / Buildings / High-tech / Infrastructure) - UK (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
Are you a bit tired of the standard, old-fashioned way of doing things in the construction industry? 
Do you get deep satisfaction from making things run more efficiently using a good dose of common sense and maybe a bit of technology? 
Have you always cared about the importance of proper planning and the connection between the schedule and the real, day-to-day delivery of the job? 
Have you ever wanted to work a bit more flexibly but still be hands-on in construction and improving the industry? 
Sounds like a dream. Well, it isn’t. It’s quite real! Read on. 
____________________________________________________________
We are Laminar Projects!
 
If you’ve already heard about us, you’re probably reading this because you’re tired of the typical, chaotic ways of doing things in construction. But in case you haven’t, we’re a high-end project management consultancy and tech developer with a focus on upgrading the way construction projects are delivered.
 
Improving construction strengthens the very foundation of human civilisation. (Check out our short film about it.)
We bring transparency and control to projects through a pragmatic mix of the latest tech, our own processes, and a big dose of common sense. We then take our deep understanding of these projects and we invest heavily into developing the digital solutions that anyone can use to deliver their projects better. (Check out Shape, our construction management tech, to see what we’re doing.)
 
The core of all this is our true secret sauce: our people. We only recruit the very best, both in capability and personality. We’re deeply focused on designing a new type of organisation that’s optimised for the flourishing of the people in the team first and foremost. People who join us develop fast as a whole person in ways they never imagined. (Read more about our vision and missions.)
 
This approach has allowed us to grow from just two people in 2017 to over 220 today. We have a stable, repeat client base across infrastructure and complex building projects in the UK and internationally, and we’re still growing fast. Joining us isn’t just some “job”. It’s a transformative educational experience. We challenge you to be your best self in all aspects of life. There are many diverse and interesting challenges available. It’s up to you to guide yourself into whichever areas you’re most interested – we’ll enable it. 
 
(Get to know us better by watching a few more of our videos.)
 
Core values for a good life
 
A life of human flourishing is all about meaningful relationships and challenging yourself to create a positive impact, so our values reflect the four levels of relationships that each of us has:
 
- Grow yourself – your relationship with yourself 
- Care about people – your relationship with others around you 
- Execute to greatness – your relationship with your team 
- Build civilisation – your relationship with humanity and the world 
 
We enshrined our values in our vision:
 
We exist so that everyone in our team can flourish in a high-impact community that:
 
- Connects us with meaningful relationships 
- Inspires us to develop ourselves to become better humans 
- Empowers us to pursue our own learning adventures 
 
By first doing this, we can achieve the highest levels of value for the world.
 
And enable the achievement of our vision through our two missions:
 
- To fully digitalise the construction of human civilisation 
- To create a new type of organisation that enables human flourishing while delivering a huge positive impact on society 
____________________________________________________________
The Role 
 
Purpose of the role 
 
You’ll be enhancing the delivery of the most complex and interesting projects in the world through the power of project planning to the very highest standards. You’ll devise strategies and tactics to improve the way the project is delivered. You’ll translate this knowledge into a logic-linked plan and analyse it using planning software. Then you’ll use the plan to help the teams understand what to prioritise. 
 
Your team 
 
This role is part of our Project Management Consultancy team which focuses on:
 
- Understanding what the real problems of projects are 
- Implementing the best solutions to those problems 
- Developing scalable best practices, tools and technology 
 
More specifically, you’ll be part of our Project Planning Team, who are industry leaders in the planning of complex construction projects. Your initial leader will be one of our planning discipline directors.
 
Your top three objectives 
 
1. To make construction projects deliver to near perfection 
2. To create scalable and repeatable solutions to common problems 
3. To develop yourself and everyone around you 
 
Your top five responsibilities 
 
1. Own the plan: Own the project plan for one or more projects and ensure that the project is working to it effectively. Ensure delays are mitigated and managed commercially 
2. Own the outcome: You're responsible for putting in your best effort to ensure the project team’s understanding and focus on the plan – no matter how stubborn they are 
3. Report and inform: Provide simple, actionable reports to stakeholders at all levels that help them deliver their part of the project more efficiently and effectively 
4. Make scalable solutions: Develop scalable and repeatable best practices and tools in collaboration with the team so that long-term impact is achieved 
5. Develop everyone: Maximise the development of your team personally and professionally and educate our clients to improve as well  
 
You must have:
 
- A construction engineering background: You have at least 2+ years of experience on construction projects, experience in project planning both software and principles, as well as decent Excel skills, and a strong interest in data
- Communication skills: You’re proficient in written and verbal English and have the charisma and influence to get construction people to do new things and take the best approach 
- Leadership capabilities: You lead yourself proactively and lead others by asking the right questions and challenging them 
- Impact: You have a track record of making projects and organisations better beyond just doing the basics – implementing scalable, repeatable solutions that had a significant positive impact 
 
Laminar isn’t the place for you if any of the following is true: 
 
- You want an easy, chilled-out role without much challenge 
- You like to be the smartest person in the room 
- You don’t like continuously receiving honest candid feedback 
- You prefer to do your own thing rather than work with a team
____________________________________________________________
Frequently Asked Questions 
 
What kinds of projects would I be working on?
It’s common for people to be exposed to several projects in their first year with us. You’ll work on some of the most complex and interesting environments in the world. We’ve delivered over 100 data centres internationally, many of them fast-tracked and multi-package. Our teams have supported flagship infrastructure programmes like HS2 through integrated planning and digital delivery, contributed to over $30bn in power generation and transmission projects, and played a key role in the development of high-containment labs and R&D campuses for some of the world’s most advanced industrial and life sciences clients. You might find yourself working in sectors such as data centres, infrastructure (including defense, rail, and highways), high tech (such as advanced manufacturing, pharmaceuticals, and semiconductors), or complex building projects. These aren’t hands-off assignments. They’re dynamic, hands-on environments designed for people who want to be challenged. We bring back the lessons from every project to help our team grow and deliver the highest levels of value. (Check out our case stories.) 
 
Who are our clients?
Major owners/operators and main contractors with project values between £1m and £1bn+ globally. 
 
Where would I be working?
One week you might be working from home. The next, you might travel to the site to meet the construction teams and help organise them. Maybe you’ll pop into our London office for a workshop or a beer. Maybe you’ll fly out to exotic (and sometimes not!) locations in Europe or the Middle East to visit clients. It really depends on what you want to get involved in and what fits with your life. 
 
How does what I do connect with the long-term impact on the construction industry? 
You’re tasked with understanding and solving common problems. We don’t want to reinvent the wheel every time, so you’ll be responsible for documenting new solutions and evolving ones we’ve developed. This goes into our knowledge repository, which we’re going to open source to the industry. 
 
The knowledge you capture will be used by us to build new products. You’ll constantly test those products in the field, so we can rapidly iterate and improve them for anyone in the industry to use. 
____________________________________________________________
Benefits
 
The standard stuff: 
 
- Health Insurance Scheme. Comprehensive private health coverage – for you and your family. Because your well-being is our priority 
- Pension Scheme. A competitive plan to help you plan for the long term – plus salary sacrifice options available to maximise your savings 
- Bonus Scheme. As a permanent member of the team, you’ll share in our success. Our annual bonus is designed to reward both the now and the future – with a flexible mix of cash and high-growth equity that you choose. Bonuses are discretionary and based on performance 
- Professional body membership. One fee covered per year – so you can stay connected to your field and develop your craft 
- Cycle to Work Scheme. A tax-efficient way to get wheels – and do your bit for the environment 
 
The life-changing stuff:
 
- In-house coaching. Regular 1:1 coaching sessions, fully confidential, to help you navigate challenges, build self-awareness, and grow intentionally – professionally and as a human being
- Equity upside. As we grow, you grow. Our generous equity scheme is especially powerful for those who stay with us on our journey. You help us build the future – and own a piece of it
- Flexible working. Work where it makes sense – most of our team works from home, visiting sites or clients regularly. We care about outcomes, not clock-ins
- Relentless development. Our goal is for every year here to be worth five years of development anywhere else. You’ll get a coach, a mentor, honest feedback, and a culture that challenges you to keep levelling up
____________________________________________________________
Important! Applying properly
 
We get thousands of applications so please write us a letter as part of your application explaining:
 
- Why you want to join us 
- What you’ll bring to the team 
 
We aren't a giant, faceless corporation; we really care about the people who want to join our team, so your letter will be read carefully. After that, we’ll reach out to you to schedule a casual conversation to help you get to know us a bit better and tell us a bit about yourself. A couple of technical and personal assessments follow to understand your capability based on our own development matrix.  
 
This is to ensure that when you join, you’re starting at the right level of responsibility.

  • Significant experience in architecting, specifying, and designing low-power, mixed-signal components for consumer, industrial, automotive or healthcare markets

  • Broad system-level knowledge across wider application space
  • Strong analytical and modelling skills

jobs.title: Embedded Software Engineer (NWB)
jobs.description:
For over four decades, Cirrus Logic has been propelled by the top engineers in mixed-signal processing. Our rockstar team thrives on solving complex challenges with innovative end-user solutions for the world's top consumer brands. Cirrus Logic is also known for its award-winning culture, built on a foundation of inclusion and fairness, meaningful community engagement, and delivering enjoyable employee experiences at every turn. We’re looking for an Embedded Software Engineer who thrives close to the hardware and enjoys building high-performance, reliable firmware for DSP architecture and microcontrollers (e.g., RISC V and Arm Cortex M/A). You’ll design and implement real-time embedded software, optimize compute-heavy pipelines, and collaborate with hardware and systems teams to bring products from concept to production.
 
This role suits someone who can move comfortably between architecture/design, low-level firmware, and performance tuning—especially where latency, throughput, power, and determinism matter.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design, implement, and maintain embedded firmware for DSP cores and MCUs (RISC V and/or Arm).
  • Build and optimize real-time signal-processing pipelines (fixed-point and/or floating-point), potentially including FFTs, filters, modulation/demodulation, codecs, feature extraction, or control loops.
  • Develop firmware using a mix of C/C++ (and selective assembly where appropriate), with strong focus on performance, memory, and power optimization.
  • Work with SoC/board peripherals: DMA, timers, SPI, I²C, UART, I²S/TDM, PWM, GPIO, and relevant bus fabrics.
  • Bring up new hardware: boot flows, clocks, memory maps, interrupt vectors, peripheral init, and early validation.
  • Implement and debug drivers and RTOS components (e.g., Zephyr or equivalent), including task scheduling, synchronization primitives, and ISR design.
  • Develop test strategies: unit tests, hardware-in-the-loop tests, test automation, and manufacturing/production diagnostics.
  • Use debugging/profiling tools: JTAG/SWD, logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, trace (ETM/ITM), and cycle-accurate profiling when available.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with hardware, FPGA/ASIC, systems, and application teams to define requirements and interfaces.
  • Contribute documentation: architecture notes, interface specs, timing budgets, work packages, and bring-up guides.
  • Participate in code reviews and help establish best practices for embedded quality, safety, and maintainability.

    • Required Skills and Qualifications:
  • Strong professional experience developing embedded firmware in C/C++ for MCUs and/or DSPs.
  • Hands-on experience with RISC V and/or Arm architecture (Cortex M/A), including interrupts, memory, caches, and performance characteristics.
  • Solid understanding of embedded software fundamentals:
  • register-level programming, memory-mapped I/O
  • concurrency (ISRs, RTOS tasks), race conditions, timing determinism
  • fixed-point arithmetic, numerical precision, and overflow/underflow management
  • Proven ability to optimize firmware: cycle counting, memory layout, DMA usage, cache behavior, minimizing latency and jitter.
  • Comfortable with toolchains and build systems:
  • GCC/LLVM-based toolchains, cross-compilation
  • CMake/Make, Meson, linker scripts, map files
  • Strong debugging skills with hardware and firmware:
  • JTAG/SWD debugging
  • root-cause analysis of timing and performance issues
  • Source control expertise (Git) and disciplined engineering practices (code reviews, CI).

    • Preferred Skills and Qualifications:
  • Languages: C, C++, (optional) assembly, Python for test tooling/scripts
  • Architectures: RISC V, Arm Cortex M/A, DSP cores
  • RTOS/OS: Zephyr, embedded Linux (optional)
  • Tools: JTAG/SWD debuggers, GDB, OpenOCD/J-Link, logic analyzer, oscilloscope, trace tools
  • Practices: profiling, timing analysis, unit/integration testing, CI/CD for embedded
  • Experience with common DSP libraries/techniques (e.g., CMSIS-DSP, vendor DSP libs) and SIMD/vector optimization patterns.
  • Experience with Zephyr, or embedded Linux on Arm.
  • Familiarity with bootloaders, secure boot, OTA update mechanisms, and field diagnostics.
  • Understanding of digital communications, or audio, processing domains.
  • Exposure to safety/security standards (e.g., MISRA C/C++, IEC 61508, ISO 26262)

Master Data Management Supplier Engagement Lead, Global Business Services

 

At IVC Evidensia, we are a leading veterinary services provider in Europe and North America with more than 2,500 clinics and hospitals across 19 countries and around 42,000 employees. We aim to have an extraordinary impact on animal lives, supporting in the region of 25,000 animals every single day across our international network. IVC Evidensia exists to champion the long-term health and welfare of animals and deliver our purpose of Healthy Animals, Happy Owners.

 

The GBS Master Data Management Supplier Engagement Lead is a new role and is responsible for establishing and leading a proactive, business-facing supplier engagement and governance function within Global Business Solutions (GBS).

 

The role will act as the primary point of coordination between suppliers, clinics, Country Finance, Procurement and GBS, ensuring that new suppliers are onboarded efficiently, accurately and in accordance with established master data governance standards, financial controls and procurement policies.

 

Leading a team of GBS Regional Supplier Engagement SMEs, the role will drive a consistent, standardised approach to supplier onboarding, validation, engagement and ongoing supplier data quality across all operating countries.

 

A key focus will be to embed preventative controls at the point of supplier creation, ensuring supplier records, payment methods, payment terms, banking information and supporting documentation are accurate, complete and appropriately authorised before being established in Oracle.

 

The role will also support and be consulted on the targeted supplier data improvement and remediation initiatives, including Direct Debit and Payment Terms Rationalisation, working collaboratively with Procurement, PTP and Country Finance to reduce payment exceptions, strengthen compliance and improve end-to-end Procure-to-Pay performance.

 
 

Key Accountabilities/Responsibilities:

 

Supplier Onboarding & Front-Line Governance

 
* Own and standardise the end-to-end supplier onboarding process across GBS-supported countries
* Establish minimum mandatory supplier information, documentation and validation requirements before supplier creation
* Ensure appropriate validation of supplier legal identity, tax information, banking details, payment methods and payment terms
* Implement preventative controls to minimise duplicate suppliers, incomplete records, incorrect payment arrangements and unauthorised supplier creation
* Ensure exceptions to supplier onboarding standards are documented, approved and escalated in line with established governance
* Establish clear ownership and approval requirements between Clinics, Country Finance, Procurement and GBS
 

Supplier Engagement & Stakeholder Management

 
* Act as the primary escalation and coordination point for supplier onboarding issues

Supplier Master Data Quality & Continuous Improvement

* Develop supplier data quality reporting and root-cause analysis to identify recurring onboarding issues

* Drive an ownership and continuous improvement culture across the Supplier Engagement function
* Support the future evolution of supplier engagement capabilities, including supplier self-service and workflow automation

* 5–8+ years of relevant experience within Master Data Management, Procurement Operations, Procure-to-Pay, Supplier Management, Finance Shared Services or Global Business Services, including experience leading teams or cross-functional service delivery
* Demonstrated experience in supplier onboarding, supplier master data governance, vendor creation processes and supplier data quality management
* Strong understanding of end-to-end Procure-to-Pay processes, including supplier creation, invoice processing, payment terms, payment methods and associated financial controls

jobs.title: Activation and Production Testing Specialist
jobs.description:
🌍 About Hopae

At Hopae, we're building the world's most trusted digital identity platform — private, secure, and built for real life. We believe identity should be in your control — not locked behind outdated systems or centralized gatekeepers.

Our product, Hopae Connect, lets businesses verify real people across borders through a single API — no need to build country-by-country integrations themselves. Our technology powers instant, privacy-first verification across fintech, credentials, supply chain, and gaming — for IDV providers, e-signature platforms, and enterprises who need identity to just work, everywhere.

Backed by top global investors, Hopae operates across Seoul, Paris, Luxembourg, and San Francisco, bringing together exceptional talent from over 10 nationalities. We move fast, think globally, and build products that define the future of identity.

💡 Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Global DNA: Work with exceptional peers across Seoul, Paris, and San Francisco

  • High Impact: Build technology shaping the global trust and identity landscape

  • Ownership Culture: No micromanagement — full trust, full accountability

  • Elite Standards: Work fast, learn fast, and grow with world-class peers

  • Inclusive & Respectful: 10+ nationalities, diverse perspectives, one vision

  • Growth Mindset: Access mentorship, leadership visibility, and continuous learning

What You Will Do

A signed contract is the start of a customer’s journey, not the finish line. On our Activation & Assurance team, you’ll help customers complete provider onboarding, understand how our product works, and validate their integration with real production testers.

This is a junior, hands-on role for someone who enjoys organized work, clear communication, and getting the details right. You’ll start with established playbooks and test procedures, then help improve them as you learn the product and settle into the team.

  • Run activation workflows. Follow provider-specific manuals to submit onboarding requests and coordinate registrations, approvals, and contracting steps with identity providers. Receive credentials and enter them accurately into the Hopae Console, following security procedures and checking the customer and environment.

  • Provide eID-specific activation guidance. When customer involvement is needed, explain the provider’s activation requirements, collect the necessary information, and guide customers through the steps they need to complete.

  • Recruit and manage production testers. Find and onboard testers for the countries and identity providers involved, confirm their eligibility and availability, explain what they need to do, and maintain an organized, reliable tester network.

  • Coordinate and run real-world tests. Once a customer has integrated our product, organize testing with real production testers. Agree on schedules, prepare test scenarios and instructions, guide testers through the user journey, and keep testing on track. Support recurring production checks using the team’s established procedures.

  • Collect evidence and report results. Gather tester feedback and supporting evidence, check outcomes against the expected user flow, and produce clear reports showing what was tested, what worked, what failed, and what still needs attention.

  • Raise issues and follow through. Turn test findings into actionable issues with reproduction steps and relevant evidence. Coordinate with Engineering, Product, and provider-facing teams, track progress, and arrange retesting when fixes are ready. You don’t need to fix the underlying code yourself, but you do need to keep the follow-up moving.

  • Keep people and information aligned. Maintain accurate records of activation status, test coverage, schedules, and blockers. Keep customers, testers, and internal teams informed, and flag missing information or schedule risks early.

  • Help improve how we work. As you gain experience, identify recurring friction and improve checklists, documentation, and handoffs. You’ll also help monitor existing operational automations, check their outputs, and flag exceptions or improvement opportunities.

Who You Are

  • You are detail-driven and dependable. You can follow defined processes consistently, check information carefully, and complete repeatable work without losing accuracy or leaving loose ends.

  • You work in an organized way. You can manage multiple requests and test schedules, keep records current, and follow up with the right people to meet agreed timelines.

  • You communicate clearly and patiently. You’re comfortable working with customers, external testers, and identity providers. You can explain instructions, ask useful questions, and keep people informed without overwhelming them.

  • You are good at gathering and structuring information. You can turn scattered feedback, screenshots, and observations into a clear test report or issue that someone else can act on. You distinguish confirmed findings from things that still need investigation.

  • You have practical technical curiosity. You can learn your way around APIs, credentials, configuration settings, and test versus production environments. You don’t need to be a developer or an identity expert, but you should be comfortable reading documentation and following technical instructions.

  • You know when to ask for help. You recognize when something falls outside the playbook, escalate with useful context, and handle credentials and tester information carefully.

  • You want to grow beyond the checklist. You’re happy to learn established workflows first, then use what you’ve learned to suggest practical process improvements. We don’t expect you to arrive with every answer.

  • You work comfortably in Korean and English. You can communicate with local teammates and international customers, testers, and providers, both in writing and in conversation.

  • Bonus: Experience in customer onboarding, operations, testing coordination, technical support, or customer success. Familiarity with B2B SaaS or digital identity is helpful, but not required.

⚡️ Fast Facts

  • 💰 $13.5M+ raised from top global investors

  • 📦 2.6M+ downloads of our sd-jwt-js library

  • 🌍 10+ nationalities across 3 hubs

  • 🔬 82 eID research projects completed

  • 🌐 3 projects accepted into the OpenWallet Foundation

🎁 Benefits & Culture

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Remote-friendly work model

  • Real ownership from Day 1

  • High-impact, global product

  • Multicultural, respectful team

🧭 Interview Process

  1. Recruiter Intro Call (30 min) – Get to know Hopae

  2. Functional or Technical Interview (45 min) – Dive into your skills

  3. Culture Fit Conversation (45 min) – Collaboration & alignment

  4. Offer 🎉

As a Staff Platform Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for the internal platform that powers Enpal's applications and services. You'll partner closely with engineering leadership, senior platform engineers, and development teams, acting as a force multiplier through mentorship, architectural guidance, and hands-on contribution to the platform's hardest problems.

  • Elevating the developer experience. Treat the platform as a product for internal teams: drive usability, reliability, and documentation improvements that let engineers ship faster and safer, and define the metrics that prove it.

  • Mentoring and growing engineers. Coach platform and junior engineers, review designs and code, and raise the overall technical level of the team through pairing, documentation, and feedback.

  • Leading complex, cross-team initiatives. Take ownership of high-impact projects that span multiple teams, from scoping and design through rollout, with minimal oversight.

  • Driving continuous improvement. Proactively identify risks, inefficiencies, and technical debt, and lead the changes that materially improve stability, performance, and automation.

  • Partnering across the organization. Work closely with developers, operations, security, and leadership to understand real needs and translate them into platform solutions and roadmap priorities.

We are looking for an experienced engineer with deep technical expertise, strong judgment, and a track record of leading platform initiatives.

  • Contributions to open-source platform or infrastructure tooling.

  • Experience operating in regulated or compliance-sensitive environments (e.g., energy, fintech).

jobs.title: Account Manager / Key Account Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Die Baubranche ist eine 14-Billionen-Euro-Industrie, die noch immer auf E-Mails, Excel-Tabellen und eingescannten PDFs läuft. Cosuno ersetzt das durch KI. Generalunternehmer schreiben ihre Projekte auf unserer Plattform an mehr als 250.000 Nachunternehmer aus, und unsere agentische KI findet die passenden Firmen, erkennt Auffälligkeiten in Angeboten und vergleicht jeden Preis mit 6,5 Millionen Datenpunkten aus über 136 Milliarden Euro verarbeitetem Angebotsvolumen. Jede Ausschreibung macht die KI klüger. Die Ergebnisse sind messbar: Generalunternehmer senken ihre Kosten um rund 6 %, Nachunternehmer gewinnen 22 % mehr Aufträge, und jeder neue Generalunternehmer-Kunde hat sich in diesem Jahr für unser KI-Produkt entschieden. 2019 in Berlin gegründet und von Cherry Ventures und Spark Capital mit über 40 Millionen Euro finanziert, skalieren wir mit diesem Kapital jetzt Sales, Customer Success und Marketing. Und genau hier kommst du ins Spiel.

Die Rolle

Du übernimmst ein eigenes Book von rund 70 bis 90 Generalunternehmern, Bauträgern und Planern und stellst gemeinsam mit unserem Consulting-Team eine erfolgreiche Aktivierung sicher. Du sicherst die Verlängerung, baust Nutzung und Vertrag aus und merkst früh, wenn ein Kunde abrutscht. Wo ein Kunde noch nicht richtig angekommen ist, holst du ihn gemeinsam mit dem Consulting-Team in die Nutzung.

Verlängerungen, Upgrades und Cross-Sell verhandelst du selbst, mit Geschäftsführung, Einkauf und Kalkulation. Jede Vertragsfrist der nächsten zwölf Monate hast du im Blick, ab 120 Tagen davor läuft dein Renewal-Ablauf, und deinen Forecast pflegst du jede Woche.

Als Key Account Manager machst du das für unsere größten Kunden: Unternehmensgruppen mit mehreren Gesellschaften und Standorten, vielen Entscheidern und längeren Deal Cycles.

Woran wir dich nach 12 Monaten messen

  • Dein Book trägt mehr ARR als zu Beginn: Verlängerungen, Upsell und Cross-Sell sind größer als Kündigungen und Downgrades.

  • Die Kündigungen in deinem Book liegen unter deinem Ziel, und jede Frist der nächsten zwölf Monate hat eine Renewal-Opportunity mit Forecast-Kategorie.

  • Dein Forecast steht jede Woche, ohne dass jemand nachfragen muss.

  • Warnsignale in deinem Book, etwa sinkende Nutzung oder ein weggefallener Key User, haben schnell einen Plan.

  • Als Key Account Manager: Mehr Gesellschaften und Standorte deiner Kunden arbeiten mit Cosuno, und deine großen Renewals landen dort, wo du sie vorhergesagt hast.

Wer bei Cosuno erfolgreich ist

  • Ownership. Du sprichst über eigene Fehler, bevor jemand fragt, und darüber, was du daraus geändert hast.

  • Speed. Du löst Probleme pragmatisch und heute, nicht perfekt und nächstes Quartal.

  • Drive. Wenn du zur Monatsmitte unter Ziel liegst, rufst du mehr Kunden an, nicht weniger.

  • Low Ego. Du teilst, was bei dir funktioniert hat, damit das Team besser wird.

Diese Rolle ist für dich, wenn

  • du ein Book mit vielen Kunden lieber selbst steuerst, als fünf Großkunden zu betreuen.

  • du Verlängerungen verhandelst und dabei den Preis hältst, statt Rabatt zu geben.

  • du schon einmal den echten Kündigungsgrund hinter dem genannten gefunden hast.

  • du deine Zahlen kennst und sie dich motivieren.

  • du mit Geschäftsführern im Mittelstand auf Augenhöhe sprichst und verstehen willst, wie am Bau eingekauft wird.

Diese Rolle ist nichts für dich, wenn

  • du Customer Success als Beziehungspflege verstehst und Verkaufen vermeidest.

  • du aus Support, Service oder reinem Onboarding kommst und noch nie eine eigene Zielzahl hattest.

  • du zehn Enterprise-Accounts gewohnt bist und 70 Kunden als zu viel empfindest.

  • du lieber über Transformation präsentierst, als einen Vertrag zu verlängern.

Harte Anforderungen

  • Rund 2 bis 3 Jahre im Account Management, Customer Success oder Sales im B2B-Umfeld, idealerweise SaaS, davon mindestens ein Jahr mit eigener Verantwortung für Bestandskunden und Umsatz.

  • Belegbare Ergebnisse bei Verlängerungen, Upsell oder Kündigungen in den letzten Perioden.

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau. Gutes Englisch und Erfahrung mit Bau, Immobilien oder Vertical SaaS sind ein Plus.

  • Für Key Account Manager zusätzlich: 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung mit Unternehmensgruppen oder Konzernkunden, mehreren Entscheidern und längeren Deal Cycles.

Vergütung

jobs.description:
About the Role

You will win and grow our largest client relationships: enterprise and upper Mittelstand companies in DACH that want to run their commercial processes on one platform and automate them with AI agents. You open doors at C level, understand the business problem better than anyone else in the room, shape the solution together with our engineers and consultants, and close deals of six figures and more.

We are not looking for a classic sales profile. We are looking for someone clients trust because they know what they are talking about: processes, data, integrations and what AI can and cannot do. Someone who listens first, asks the second and third question, and is comfortable saying "we are not the right partner for this". In a team of around 30 people, without Konzern overhead, and with direct access to our CEO.

What You'll Do

  • Own large enterprise deals end to end, from the first conversation with a C level sponsor to signature and handover to delivery.

  • Open new accounts in our focus industries, especially manufacturing (machinery and industrial tech) and construction and building materials, often companies that sell through dealers, partners and installers.

  • Lead discovery: understand the client's processes, data and systems, and turn a vague "we need something with AI" into a clear business case.

  • Sell our full model: paid Discovery, a fixed price build (portals, CPQ, field service, CRM, AI agents) and ongoing operation of the solution.

  • Shape solutions together with our solution architects and AI engineers, and sell only what we can deliver.

  • Grow accounts after go-live with new use cases, entities and agents.

  • Build your own pipeline through your network, the HubSpot partner ecosystem, referrals and targeted outreach.

  • Use AI tools in your own daily work for research, preparation and proposals.

What You Bring

Must-haves

  • At least eight years in B2B solution or services sales, including at least three years personally owning enterprise deals.

  • A track record of deals of EUR 100k and more that you originated and closed yourself, with several decision makers, procurement and IT involved.

  • A solid technical or process background (for example IT, engineering, business informatics or consulting) and real interest in AI, digitalisation and business processes. You don't code, but you can follow an architecture discussion and explain a trade-off to a CFO.

  • A consultative way of selling: you listen more than you talk, and clients describe you as helpful, not pushy.

  • Native or C2 level German and fluent English, written and spoken.

  • Within commuting distance of Böblingen and happy to travel to clients in DACH.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience at an IT consultancy, system integrator or B2B software vendor selling CRM, ERP, CPQ, PIM, field service, data or AI projects.

  • Experience selling to machine builders or building materials companies with dealer or service networks.

  • Knowledge of HubSpot, Salesforce or Microsoft Dynamics at enterprise scale.

  • Experience with structured qualification such as MEDDPICC from real deals.

Your Team

You'll be part of our Sales Function and report directly to our CEO. You'll work alongside our Sales Manager and Senior Account Executive, and on every deal closely with solution architects, AI engineers, consultants and project managers from our Practices in Böblingen and Lisbon.

Tech Stack

HubSpot Sales Hub, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, PandaDoc, Confluence, Jira, Microsoft Teams, Claude. On the solution side you'll meet HubSpot, ERP integrations, custom portals and AI agents built on large language models.

What We Offer

  • Attractive package with a fixed salary and a variable component that rewards good deals, not just more deals.

  • 31 vacation days per year: 30 days plus one extra company day for Christmas or a holiday of your choice. Baden-Württemberg public holidays come on top.

  • Hybrid working with two office days per week at our Böblingen HQ.

  • Company pension plan (Allianz) with an employer contribution from your second year that grows with tenure.

  • Business Bike leasing with the 0.25 percent tax advantage, full insurance, annual service and free brand choice.

  • Lunch subsidy of 5 EUR tax-free per working day, up to 100 EUR per month.

  • Corporate Benefits discount platform covering travel, tech, fashion, mobility and insurance.

  • Direct impact. Flat hierarchy, direct line to the CEO, and the chance to shape how a growing AI consultancy sells.

About Thorit

Thorit is the AI & CRM consultancy for the agent-native enterprise. Agentic means software that acts on goals instead of waiting for clicks. As a Diamond HubSpot Partner we work with enterprise B2B clients in DACH and the Nordics, building the agent layer on top of HubSpot and the systems around it, then operating it with them.

Ready to Apply?

Send your application via Ashby. A cover letter is optional, but please include a short description of the largest deal you personally originated and closed: what the client bought, rough deal size, how many people were involved in the decision, and what made the difference.

jobs.title: Head of Business Unit Solaire H/F
jobs.description:
🐙 Rejoins la révolution énergétique chez Octopus Energy !
 
Octopus Energy, fournisseur d’énergie verte présent à l’international, a lancé sa filiale Octopus Energy Services pour accompagner ses clients dans la décarbonation complète de leur foyer. Déjà bien implantée au Royaume-Uni, cette entité propose un ensemble de solutions techniques : installation de panneaux photovoltaïques, de bornes de recharge pour véhicules électriques et de systèmes de chauffage décarboné, le tout avec une approche centrée sur la qualité, l’innovation et sans sous-traitance.
 
Tu veux un job qui a du sens ? Octopus Energy Services a démarré son activité en 2024, avec un objectif clair : aider les particuliers à réduire leurs factures énergétiques tout en participant activement à la transition énergétique. Et aujourd’hui on a besoin de toi pour propulser notre croissance !

Nous sommes aujourd’hui une cinquantaine de salariés et nous visons 10 M€ de chiffre d'affaires en 2027, ce qui nous placera parmi les leaders du marché. Le cap derrière : que tout client qui veut s'équiper pense à nous en premier, parce que nous sommes la référence sur la qualité de l'accompagnement et des produits que nous vendons.

Pour tenir ce cap, nous nous structurons en trois BU : 

  • La BU Solaire reste notre activité historique et notre cœur de métier : vente et pose avec nos propres installateu·rices.

  • Notre réseau de Partenaires Certifiés, pour accompagner les clients sur des travaux que nous ne proposons pas en propre (vente et pose de pompe à chaleur notamment).

  • Le matériel, afin de lancer sur le marché français les produits fabriqués par le groupe, comme sa pompe à chaleur Cosy, que l’on souhaite proposer à nos Partenaires Certifiés. 

Guillaume, Directeur Général Délégué, qui a lancé la filiale, supervisera les trois et cherche la personne qui dirigera la BU Solaire, notre activité historique.

Ta mission :

Tu diriges la BU Solaire comme un·e véritable dirigeant·e de business : tu fixes le cap, tu portes les résultats et tu construis l'organisation qui nous fera passer à l'échelle. Ton premier chantier : monter en cadence de pose, sans dégrader la qualité, tout en améliorant la rentabilité de la BU en 2027. Tu le fais depuis le terrain autant que depuis le bureau.

Tes responsabilités seront les suivantes : 


1. Stratégique : Définir le cap et faire grandir la BU.

Tu portes la vision, la stratégie de développement de la BU et tu prends les arbitrages structurants, notamment :

  • Fixer la trajectoire de la BU et trancher les décisions qui font avancer le business ;

  • Décider, le moment venu, des extensions : nouvelle zone géographique, nouvelle ligne de produit ;

  • Représenter la BU en interne et faire l'interface avec Octopus Energy France (fourniture d'énergie, offre bundlée pose + contrat + pilotage batterie), les fonctions support partagées et les deux autres BU.


    • 2. Économique : Piloter le P&L, la rentabilité et les investissements

    Tu es owner des chiffres de la BU, tu devras notamment :

  • Suivre la rentabilité à chaque maillon de la chaîne (vente, étude, pose, SAV) et les faire suivre à chaque manager ;

  • Travailler avec eux à les améliorer : coût d'acquisition, délais de pose, SAV ;

  • Produire les chiffres du reporting groupe et savoir les défendre.


    • 3. Managériale et opérationnelle : Faire grandir les managers et structurer l'organisation.

    Tu fais monter les responsables de chaque équipe pour qu’ils portent la montée en cadence de la BU dans une organisation qui grandit : 

  • Accompagner les managers d’équipe au quotidien pour qu'ils·elles fassent grandir ses équipes, y compris dans les moments difficiles ;

  • Structurer, avec les équipes techniques, la montée en cadence de pose ;

  • Animer le collectif et incarner la culture de l'entreprise : exigence de qualité, jalons, victoires célébrées.


    • Ce qu'on cherche :

    Ce qui compte d'abord, c'est qui tu es : 

  • Tu t’intéresses vraiment aux gens, tu es exigeant·e et tu dis les choses clairement, dans le respect de la personne en face.

  • Tu sais engager des équipes pluridisciplinaires : commerce, administratif, technique et terrain ne parlent pas la même langue, tu fais le lien.

  • Tu accompagnes tes managers pour qu'ils fassent monter leurs propres équipes.

  • Tu es à l'aise dans une entreprise en construction : on teste, on se trompe, on recommence.

  • Tu prends ton sujet en main et tu as le courage managérial de dire les choses.

  • Tu es proactif·ve, tu trouves des solutions en autonomie et tu fais s'activer les équipes autour de toi.

    • Côté compétences techniques :

  • Tu as déjà dirigé une activité opérationnelle avec des équipes de terrain. Le solaire résidentiel n'est pas obligatoire.

  • Tu lis un P&L et tu défends tes chiffres devant une direction.

  • Tu as une vraie vision business : tu relies l'opérationnel à la rentabilité.

  • Tu es prêt·e à aller sur le terrain, régulièrement.

  • Tu sais communiquer (écrit et oral) en anglais pour échanger avec le Groupe. 

    • Conditions :

  • Contrat : CDI – Statut Cadre

  • Localisation : Paris ou Lille (déplacements à prévoir entre les deux bureaux et sur le terrain)

  • Date de prise de poste : Dès que possible

  • Rémunération : À définir selon profil et expérience

    •  

    Processus de recrutement :

    1. Premier échange avec Chloé, notre Talent Partner en charge de ce recrutement 

    2. Échange visio de 30 min avec Guillaume pour comprendre tes motivations pour le poste 

    3. Entretien en présentiel à Paris ou Lille avec Guillaume et potentiellement un échange avec un des membres du COMEX Octopus France

    Pourquoi tu vas adorer travailler pour nous ?

    Tu veux connaitre le salaire ? Demande-le nous ! Lors de notre premier contact, c’est un point que nous abordons toujours, car même si nous prenons soin de définir des grilles les plus justes possibles, il nous semble également important de faire correspondre ton expérience au bon salaire. Nous aurons l’occasion de t’en dire plus sur la manière dont nous avons défini le salaire et sur les autres avantages dont tu pourras bénéficier si tu nous rejoins ! Sache enfin que nous pouvons avoir un certain degré de flexibilité, car nous ne voudrions jamais que le salaire soit une raison pour laquelle quelqu’un·e ne postule pas chez Octopus - ce qui est le plus important pour nous est de trouver le bon Octofit !

    Certifiée depuis 2024 et 4e en 2025, Octopus Energy France est classée 1ère sur plus de 200 entreprises au classement Great Place to Work 2026 ! Cela reflète bien notre engagement pour un environnement de travail épanouissant !

    Nous sommes une organisation où les gens apprennent, décident et construisent plus rapidement. Où ils travaillent de manière autonome, avec des gens extraordinaires, sur des projets qui innovent. Intéressement au capital, flex-office, excellente mutuelle, forfait mobilité douce, prise en charge d’une partie de ton titre de transport au-delà du minimum légal, et même des jours de congés spéciaux pour t’investir dans un projet associatif qui te tient à coeur… Nous voulons que ton investissement soit récompensé par des avantages auxquels tu tiens vraiment !

    Chez Octopus, nous cherchons des personnes foncièrement bienveillantes et empathiques. L’égalité des chances nous tient à cœur et nous veillons à offrir un environnement de travail inclusif et équitable. Nous t’invitons à postuler, quels que soient ton âge, genre, vie conjugale, couleur, handicap, grossesse ou parentalité, origine, convictions religieuses ou orientation sexuelle.

Join the Future of Work ! Malt is Europe's leading freelance marketplace, connecting over 1,000,000 talented freelancers with 100,000+ companies. Founded in 2013, we're transforming how work gets done through our tech-powered, human-centered platform. What makes us different:
 
- A diverse team of 600 Malters across 6 European countries
- A culture that champions equality (50% of our Comex are women) and inclusive growth
- Backed by top investors including ISAI, Serena Capital, Eurazeo Growth, Goldman Sachs, and BPI
- A mission to give everyone the freedom to work differently
 
Ready to help shape the future of work? Your next chapter starts here! 🪐
 
At Malt we believe that Ambition is the Way, so all lists of missions and responsibilities are non-exhaustive.

Key responsibilities

  • Set the Long-Term Platform Tech Strategy: Define the 2–3 year technical vision and roadmap for Malt's engineering platform — backend, frontend — alongside platform leads, ensuring architectural consistency, security, and high reliability across all engineering squads. Agentic capabilities are a central pillar of that vision, not a side project.

  • Architect Platform Foundations: Partner closely with Backend, Frontend, and SRE leads to design and build our company-wide platform foundations — from core shared infrastructure through to our agentic layer, consolidating existing POCs into unified, enterprise-grade capabilities.

  • Pioneer Agentic DevEx Workflows: Prototype, scale, and embed autonomous AI agents into the software development lifecycle (e.g., agentic MR reviews, automated code quality, and security fixes) so product teams can focus strictly on core product logic.

  • Deliver Platform-as-a-Product: Provide product engineers with self-service tools, reusable components, clear guardrails, and documentation making both our platform foundations and our autonomous workflows the natural, default way to ship software at Malt.

  • Build, Hands-On: Contribute directly to the platform. You'll write production code on the systems you design: the hardest parts, the reference implementations, the things nobody else can unblock.

  • Raise the Bar: Drive the adoption of best practices, coding standards, and high-quality engineering processes, including thorough code and architecture reviews. Foster operational excellence across the platform.

  • Mentor and Coach: Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers across the platform team, particularly Senior and mid-level engineers, helping them develop their skills, master agentic patterns, and advance their careers.

  • Drive Technical Alignment & Change Management: Act as a technical catalyst, influencing and aligning backend, frontend, and engineering leads around transformative AI agent paradigms without relying on top-down authority.


    • About you

  • Technical Expertise: You have 15+ years of professional experience in software engineering, including a proven track record operating at a Staff or Principal level in high-scale platform environments. You're highly proficient in Kotlin or Java, comfortable across GCP and modern web frameworks (e.g. Nuxt/VueJS), and at ease navigating complex backend architecture, APIs, and data models.

  • AI-Driven Innovator: Passionate about AI topics, you regularly keep up to date with the latest developments. You have already built product-grade agentic workflows within the software development lifecycle: systems engineers rely on daily to review, test, or ship code, not demos or POCs.

  • Clear leadership: You excel at working effectively in uncertain and evolving environments, managing the interaction between technical objectives and business priorities.

  • Platform as a Product Mindset: You think beyond the code. Your product is the developer experience: you're curious about the "why" behind the workflows, core components you build, proactive in proposing improvements, and you own delivery from A to Z: including the adoption, not just the architecture.

  • Resourceful: You always find a way of getting things done, even under severe staffing constraints.

  • Impactful: You demonstrate excellent ownership and problem-solving skills, with a high degree of agency in driving solutions.

  • Strong interpersonal abilities: You possess excellent written and oral communication skills in English (French is a valuable bonus).


    • How to join the mission?

    1. Initial Screening Call (45m): First exchange with Luke Singh or Alexandre Hidasi (Tech & Product Recruiters) to explore your background, career aspirations, and answer any initial questions.

    2. Manager Interview (60m): Deep dive into your technical background, domain experience, and alignment with Anaïs Ghelfi (Hiring Manager & Engineering Director).

    3. Technical Business Case & Debrief (2h): Practical architecture exercise and debrief with Staff Engineers to evaluate your systems design and agentic architecture mastery.

    4. Executive & Culture Fit Interview (2h): Final conversation with Claire (CTO) to discuss Malt’s long-term vision, followed by an informal coffee chat with Raphaël Ouazana & Pierre Reynaud.

    Malt is the perfect space to thrive personally and professionally 💫
     
    - Onboarding: Before easing into your new role, you’ll spend your first week learning about our culture, products, and services with other new joiners at our office in Paris
    - Equity: Every Malter is entitled to stock options 
    - Lunch vouchers (legal benefit): €9/day on your Swile card
    - Transportation (legal benefit): 50% reimbursement (any type of transport)
    - Healthcare insurance (legal benefit) 
    - RTT: From 8 to 12 days off per year
    - Sports: Company participation to a Gymlib (Wellpass) membership
    - Malt sabbatical: Every three years, all Malters are entitled to a one month fully paid sabbatical leave
    - Free books: If you’re interested in learning more about any topic relevant to Malt’s business, just tell us the books you’d like to read, and we’ll order them for you—without any questions asked or approval processes to follow
    - Remote work: Hybrid policy balancing on-site and home office
    - Team building events organized every year
     
    Ready? Get your ticket to Malt 🪐 
     
    At Malt, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We recruit based on skills, experience, and potential, without any form of discrimination related to age, gender, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, or disability. Our mission is to create a work environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and safe to thrive.
     
    Your profile may be subject to background screening. For more information see our candidate privacy policy.

jobs.title: Security & Compliance Engineer – GRC & Product Security – Security and IT Team
jobs.description:
About Scality

Scality solves organisations' biggest data storage challenges: growth, security, performance, and cost. Designed for end-to-end cyber resilience, only Scality S3 object storage with CORE5 safeguards data at every level of the system, from API to architecture. Its patented MultiScale Architecture enables limitless, independent scalability in all critical dimensions to meet the unpredictable demands of modern workloads. The world's most discerning companies depend on Scality to accelerate high-performance AI initiatives, optimize cloud deployments, and defend their data with confidence. Recognized as a leader by Gartner, Scality software is reliable, secure, and sustainable.


The job context

The team

Our IT & Security team builds, runs and secures Scality's IT infrastructure. It also supports the whole Scality community: employees, contractors, consultants and freelancers. We make sure everyone works in a secure, compliant and up-to-date environment. We also bring security expertise to our products (RING, ARTESCA, ADI) and to our customers.

You will join a team of 4 to 5 people with varied backgrounds (development, security, IT operations, helpdesk) and 2 to 30+ years of experience.

The mission

You will own Scality's information security compliance program and coordinate the team's security operations. You will lead our ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 (AI management system) certifications and manage vulnerability (CVE) follow-up with Engineering. 

You will answer customer security requests and audits. You will also help our products meet new regulations such as the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).

The role is about 70% governance, risk and compliance (GRC) and product security, and 30% hands-on security operations.


The job description

You will own (Responsible)

  • Security operations coordination: be the point of contact for incoming IT & Security requests, prioritize them and dispatch them within the team.
  • Vulnerability management: Assess product exposure to CVEs by leveraging internal tools powered by our Software Bills of Materials (SBOMs).. Handle customer security requests (RD tickets) with Engineering and Support until a fix version or a customer answer is delivered. Track scan and pentest reports through remediation.
  • ISO 27001 and ISO 42001 programs: maintain the framework, policies and procedures in our GRC tool. Run risk analysis and treatment plans, objectives and indicators, and the Statement of Applicability. Prepare internal and external audits and follow up on nonconformities and improvement opportunities.
  • Control management: run the monthly, quarterly and annual controls (account and access reviews across HR system and SSO, application access, offboarding checks), automate them in Jira and keep audit evidence.
  • ISMS processes: run security incident management and change management in Jira (workflows, fields, records), and the business continuity part of customer requests (ISO 22301-type questionnaires).
  • Third-party and application security reviews: assess new SaaS tools, suppliers and internal applications or automations (no-code tools, Slack or AI integrations). Keep the supplier inventory and the service account inventory up to date.
  • AI governance: maintain the AI systems inventory, review the AI features of tools before use, and follow regulatory changes (EU AI Act).
  • Personal data: maintain the personal data inventory and processing records (GDPR, CNIL guidance) together with the data protection contact.
  • Customer trust: answer security questionnaires and RFPs, and prepare evidence packages for customer audits (banking, telecom and public-sector customers).
  • Security awareness: plan and run awareness and phishing campaigns, and track participation and click rates for managers.

    • You will contribute to (Contributor)

  • Product security and certifications: prepare the EU Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) technical files per product (compliance matrix, risk assessment, SBOM, vulnerability handling, RACI). Also contribute to CISA Secure by Design commitments and UK Cyber Essentials. Bring security input to the product roadmap, the development teams and the product documentation.
  • Data leak prevention: define and tune DLP indicators and alerts (Google Workspace, Salesforce event monitoring) and investigate alerts.
  • Infrastructure security: IaaS/PaaS security, monitoring and SIEM alerting, reporting of security incidents, business continuity and disaster recovery.
  • Automation and tooling: scripts (Python, Bash) and Jira automations that reduce manual work.
  • IT operations: account, application and permission management, level 1 and 2 network and security incidents.
  • Mentoring: onboard and supervise interns or work-study students on security topics.

    • You will be informed of

    Laptop fleet and IT room hardware, SSO integration and SaaS administration, level 3 network management, CI security, and relations with external IT providers. Other team members handle these topics.


    Desired profile

    In general

  • Degree in cybersecurity, information systems or equivalent experience
  • 2 to 5 years of experience in information security, GRC or security operations
  • Based in France

    • Technical skills

  • Practical experience with ISO 27001 (2022): risk analysis, Statement of Applicability, controls, internal or certification audits
  • Knowledge of risk methodologies (ISO 27005, EBIOS RM or similar)
  • Understanding of vulnerability management: CVE, CVSS, SBOM, reading scan and pentest reports
  • Basic knowledge of identity and access management (SSO, SAML/OIDC, MFA, access reviews)
  • Ability to assess the security of a SaaS tool or an application: data flows, permissions, data retention, use of data for AI training
  • Jira (workflows, automation) and spreadsheets for control tracking
  • Python or Bash scripting for automation
  • Clear writing for policies, procedures and answers to customers

    • Bonus skills

  • ISO 42001, EU AI Act or AI risk management (e.g. ISO 23894)
  • EU Cyber Resilience Act, NIS2, CISA Secure by Design, UK Cyber Essentials
  • GDPR and personal data inventories
  • DLP, SIEM, centralized logging and monitoring
  • Linux, cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure), Terraform, Packer, SaltStack
  • Experience in a software vendor and with enterprise customers' security audits

    • Personal skills

  • Organized and rigorous: you run many topics in parallel and follow each one to closure
  • Autonomous and proactive: you follow up with other teams without waiting to be asked
  • Good communicator, able to explain security requirements to non-experts and convince them
  • Curious, eager to learn new norms and regulations as they come out
  • Willing to share knowledge and guide interns

    • Languages

  • Fluent French (the team is based in France)
  • Professional English: daily work with US teams; all policies, documentation and many customer questionnaires are in English

    • Our tools

    GRC platform (OverSecur), Jira and Confluence, OneLogin SSO, Google Workspace, Slack, Salesforce, BambooHR, phishing simulation and awareness platform, internal CVE/SBOM platform, Grafana, vSphere, Terraform, Packer, SaltStack, Python and Bash.

jobs.title: Head of Insurance Supply
jobs.description:
🍇 About grape: 
 
Our entrepreneurial spirit drives us in what we do and what we are passionate about. Our mission is to become the premier health partner in the insurance business. Recognising the need for innovation in the traditional employee insurance model we are set to revolutionize the employee insurance industry. We help companies support people before and after they get sick and to make more of their time. Our insurance solutions reduce monotonous and manual work for employees, doctors, HR & payroll managers. As we strive to lead a technology-driven transformation, we put employees first.
 
At grape we pride ourselves on our people and our culture. We continue to grow fast and that’s where you come in. Our team is dynamic, diverse and full of creative ideas. Want to join? We can’t wait to get to know you!

Your role

As Head of Insurance Supply, you will own grape’s carrier and reinsurance partnerships. You will build and diversify our capacity panel, secure the structures behind existing and new products, and ensure our insurance supply grows with the business.

Today, this responsibility is led by our CEOs. You will take it over, build it into a dedicated function and represent Insurance Supply as a member of grape’s Leadership Team.


What you’ll do:

1. Build and diversify our capacity panel

  • Develop grape’s capacity strategy for Switzerland and Liechtenstein.
  • Identify, qualify, negotiate with and onboard new carriers and reinsurers.
  • Lead relationships from the first conversation through due diligence, commercial negotiation and signed agreement.
  • Secure the contracted capacity required for grape’s annual business plan and written commitments for the following year.
  • Diversify the panel to support growth, enable new products and reduce concentration risk.

    •  

    2. Build strong carrier partnerships

  • Own carrier and reinsurer relationships at operational, commercial and executive level.
  • Establish a clear governance cadence, including operational reviews, strategic meetings and annual capacity negotiations.
  • Own commercial terms, contracts, renewals, outsourcing agreements and service levels.
  • Monitor partnership performance, resolve issues early and build relationships that grow over time.
  • Represent grape credibly across the insurance, reinsurance and broking market.

    •  

    3. Shape products and build the function

  • Design and secure the carrier and reinsurance structures required for new products.
  • Evaluate pricing, loss ratios, reserving, commissions, capital requirements and solvency implications.
  • Work closely with Actuarial, Underwriting, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Product and Distribution.
  • Own the Insurance Supply strategy, priorities, OKRs, processes and reporting.
  • Provide the Leadership Team with a clear view of capacity coverage, pipeline and risk.
  • Hire and lead a Carrier Partnerships Manager as the function grows.

    • What you’ll bring:
  • At least eight years of insurance experience, including carrier partnerships, MGA capacity management, programme business, reinsurance broking or business development at a carrier.
  • A demonstrated track record of taking capacity relationships from initial contact through negotiation to a signed binding authority, treaty or comparable agreement.
  • Strong commercial judgement and the confidence to negotiate with senior stakeholders across carriers, reinsurers, MGAs and brokers.
  • A strong understanding of insurance portfolio economics, including loss ratios, reserving, pricing, capacity and capital implications.
  • Experience building long-term external partnerships and a relevant network across the carrier, reinsurance or broking market.
  • The ability to move between strategy, relationship building, negotiation and operational detail.
  • Fluent English.

    • Strong advantage:
  • Experience working within an MGA or directly with MGA and programme structures.
  • Knowledge of Swiss and Liechtenstein employee insurance, particularly KTG, UVG and UVG-Z.
  • Familiarity with the Swiss and Liechtenstein regulatory environment.
  • German or French proficiency.
  • Experience building or leading a capacity or carrier-partnerships function.
    • If you have built insurance capacity partnerships in another European market and can transfer that experience to Switzerland and Liechtenstein, we would still like to hear from you.
    🤝 What we offer in return:
    🌱 Empowering workplace: Join a passionate team and an empowering workplace where you are given the ownership, tools, and support to make decisions and take initiative. Together we grow and build innovative solutions.
    💻  Hybrid setup: Enjoy the flexibility of our hybrid work schedule, with the freedom to work remotely or from our office in Zurich. On Thursdays, our team day, we meet together in our Zurich office.
    🪑 Home office stipend: To enable our hybrid setup, we allocate a one-off CHF 200.- home office budget to help you set up your dream workspace in the comfort of your own home.
    🌐 Internet allowance: We give you a monthly internet allowance to help cover your internet costs at home and enable you to work seamlessly from your home office.
    ⏳ Flexible working time: You can distribute your working hours the way you want to.
    🧠 Learning budget: We support you in improving your skills, acquiring new knowledge and advancing your career. We also allocate a CHF 1'500.- budget annually
    ❤️‍🩹  Well-being: Work-life balance is important to us and we foster a supportive work environment. We support you with mental health sessions with our partner Aepsy.
    🎫  Team events: Every month we gather for fun and engaging events where we can connect and bond with our colleagues and our teams.
    ✈️  Team retreats: Once a year we travel somewhere nice to bond with our colleagues.
    🚂  Travel and commute: We will cover your SBB half fare card, so we can spend some time together in the office.
    🌴 Paid vacation: You get 5 weeks (25 days) of paid vacation every year and 2 additional days of paid vacation to compensate for canton-related holidays, religious holidays, birthdays, etc. The total amount of paid vacation days per year is 27 days.
    🧖‍♀️ Wellness budget: Health and well-being looks different for everyone. You can optimize your wellness budget to best fit your needs.
    👨‍👨‍👦‍👦 Parental and adoptive leave: We offer additional time off to support employees who are balancing family and work time in the most crucial stages of family life.
    ✈️ Digital nomad: For every 3 years of employment, you can work for an extended period of time from anywhere in the world (location subject to review).
     
    🏁 Our recruitment process
    We place particular emphasis on four areas when making our selection decision: professional and technical skills, mindset & values. We evaluate these through the following steps:
     
    Step 1 - Your motivation
    To get to know you better, we invite you to a 30-minute motivational interview with our Talent Acquisition Team.
    Step 2 - Role fit
    In the first interview, we assess how well your qualifications and skills align with the role requirements. This discussion will take place with your Hiring Manager.
    Step 3 - Case study
    For roles with higher technical demands, we will invite you to complete a case study or technical assessment. This allows us to better evaluate your specific skills and problem-solving abilities.
    Step 4 - Our culture connect
    Throughout the interview process, you'll gain insight into our company culture, and we'll explore how your values and mindset align with our ways of working. The final interview will offer a deeper look into this connection, along with broader discussions about the role and our vision.
     
    Our diverse experiences, perspectives, and voices make us the company we are, and we would love to learn more about you!
    --------------------------------------------------------------------------
    Health is our foundation. Innovation drives our mission. Together, we’re building the future of employee insurance.
    At grape, collaboration isn’t just a buzzword, it’s the foundation of how we work, live, and succeed. From bold brainstorms and lessons learned, we overcome challenges side by side. Our time together is our greatest asset. Disrupting an industry that truly needs change takes courage, creativity, and team spirit and that’s exactly what defines us.
    With well-being at the core, we foster an environment where ideas and people thrive. Your growth matters as much as our mission. Whether it’s supporting your self-care, developing new solutions, or redefining how health and insurance connect, we grow together.
    Our values guide us every step of the way: keeping Health at Heart, Inventing Together, and always striving to Embrace Clarity.

We’re looking for an applied ML engineer / data scientist to build predictive models from the ground up on real, regulated insurance data. You’ll own problems end to end, from effective-dated records to production, in a domain where correctness and responsible use genuinely matter.

Starting points include pricing and risk, portfolio monitoring, claims and payment patterns, triage and return-to-work, absence, and fraud detection. grape sits on a rich dataset, though, and you’ll help find the next high-value use cases.
